\chapter{Session 2}
\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 255 -- 257}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:255}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ  لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ  لَّهُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ  يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ  وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ  وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ  وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا  وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:256}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in ṭāghūt and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is no compulsion in religion. The right direction is henceforth distinct from error. And he who rejecteth false deities and believeth in Allah hath grasped a firm handhold which will never break. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَآ إِكْرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ  قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشْدُ مِنَ ٱلْغَىِّ  فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِن بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَا  وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:257}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh is the Ally of those who believe. He brings them out from darknesses into the light. And those who disbelieve - their allies are ṭāghūt. They take them out of the light into darknesses. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah is the Protecting Guardian of those who believe. He bringeth them out of darkness into light. As for those who disbelieve, their patrons are false deities. They bring them out of light into darkness. Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ  وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُمُ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتُ يُخْرِجُونَهُم مِّنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verse 285}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:285}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allāh and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The messenger believeth in that which hath been revealed unto him from his Lord and (so do) believers. Each one believeth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers - We make no distinction between any of His messengers - and they say: We hear, and we obey. (Grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord. Unto Thee is the journeying.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ  كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ  وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا  غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 4, An-Nisā (The Women)
Verses 163 -- 166}

The 92nd revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{4:163}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants, Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon; and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We inspire thee as We inspired Noah and the prophets after him, as We inspired Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the tribes, and Jesus and Job and Jonah and Aaron and Solomon, and as We imparted unto David the Psalms;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ إِنَّآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ كَمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ مِن بَعْدِهِ  وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَعِيسَىٰ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَـٰرُونَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ  وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ زَبُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:164}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [We sent] messengers about whom We have related [their stories] to you before and messengers about whom We have not related to you. And Allāh spoke to Moses with [direct] speech.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And messengers We have mentioned unto thee before and messengers We have not mentioned unto thee; and Allah spake directly unto Moses;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ  وَكَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:165}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allāh after the messengers. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Messengers of good cheer and of warning, in order that mankind might have no argument against Allah after the messengers. Allah was ever Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رُّسُلًا مُّبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ حُجَّةٌ بَعْدَ ٱلرُّسُلِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:166}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But Allāh bears witness to that which He has revealed to you. He has sent it down with His knowledge, and the angels bear witness [as well]. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But Allah (Himself) testifieth concerning that which He hath revealeth unto thee; in His knowledge hath He revealed it; and the angels also testify. And Allah is sufficient Witness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّـٰكِنِ ٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكَ  أَنزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ  وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَشْهَدُونَ  وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 14, Ibrāhīm (Abraham)
Verses 31 -- 41}

The 72nd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{14:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَـٰلٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ  وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ  وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ  وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ  وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ  إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [i.e., Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ  فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّى  وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allāh on the earth or in the heaven.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ  وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ  إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى  رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 26, Ash-Shu`arā (The Poets)
Verses 69 -- 104}

The 47th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{26:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or do they benefit or harm you?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: See now that which ye worship,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You and your ancient forefathers?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ye and your forefathers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who created me, and He doth guide me,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:89}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:90}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:91}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:92}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:93}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:94}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُنَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:95}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the hosts of Iblis, together.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:96}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will say while they dispute therein,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:97}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:98}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:99}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It was but the guilty who misled us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:100}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So now we have no intercessors

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Now we have no intercessors

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:101}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And not a devoted friend.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nor any loving friend.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:102}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:103}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً  وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:104}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 6, Al-'An`ām (The Cattle)
Verses 74 -- 82}

The 55th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{6:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father Āzar, "Do you take idols as deities? Indeed, I see you and your people to be in manifest error."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Remember) when Abraham said unto his father Azar: Takest thou idols for gods? Lo! I see thee and thy folk in error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصْنَامًا ءَالِهَةً  إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوْمَكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thus did We show Abraham the kingdom of the heavens and the earth that he might be of those possessing certainty:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So when the night covered him [with darkness], he saw a star. He said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "I like not those that set [i.e., disappear]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When the night grew dark upon him he beheld a star. He said: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: I love not things that set.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلَّيْلُ رَءَا كَوْكَبًا  قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى  فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلْـَٔافِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when he saw the moon rising, he said, "This is my lord." But when it set, he said, "Unless my Lord guides me, I will surely be among the people gone astray."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when he saw the moon uprising, he exclaimed: This is my Lord. But when it set, he said: Unless my Lord guide me, I surely shall become one of the folk who are astray.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى  فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمْ يَهْدِنِى رَبِّى لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord; this is greater." But when it set, he said, "O my people, indeed I am free from what you associate with Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when he saw the sun uprising, he cried: This is my Lord! This is greater! And when it set he exclaimed: O my people! Lo! I am free from all that ye associate (with Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمْسَ بَازِغَةً قَالَ هَـٰذَا رَبِّى هَـٰذَآ أَكْبَرُ  فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتْ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth, as one by nature upright, and I am not of the idolaters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا  وَمَآ أَنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And his people argued with him. He said, "Do you argue with me concerning Allāh while He has guided me? And I fear not what you associate with Him [and will not be harmed] unless my Lord should will something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; then will you not remember?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: His people argued with him. He said: Dispute ye with me concerning Allah when He hath guided me? I fear not at all that which ye set up beside Him unless my Lord willeth aught. My Lord includeth all things in His knowledge. Will ye not then remember?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَحَآجَّهُ قَوْمُهُ  قَالَ أَتُحَـٰٓجُّوٓنِّى فِى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنِ  وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشْرِكُونَ بِهِٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّى شَيْـًٔا  وَسِعَ رَبِّى كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا  أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And how should I fear what you associate while you do not fear that you have associated with Allāh that for which He has not sent down to you any authority? So which of the two parties has more right to security, if you should know?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How should I fear that which ye set up beside Him, when ye fear not to set up beside Allah that for which He hath revealed unto you no warrant? Which of the two factions hath more right to safety? (Answer me that) if ye have knowledge.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَيْفَ أَخَافُ مَآ أَشْرَكْتُمْ وَلَا تَخَافُونَ أَنَّكُمْ أَشْرَكْتُم بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا  فَأَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ أَحَقُّ بِٱلْأَمْنِ  إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They who believe and do not mix their belief with injustice - those will have security, and they are [rightly] guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who believe and obscure not their belief by wrongdoing, theirs is safety; and they are rightly guided.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 21, Al-'Anbyā (The Prophets)
Verses 51 -- 73}

The 73rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{21:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ  أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً  وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ  وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 37, Aş-Şāffāt (Those who set the Ranks)
Verses 83 -- 113}

The 56th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{37:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he cast a look at the stars

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he glanced a glance at the stars

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:89}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:90}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So they turned away from him, departing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they turned their backs and went away from him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:91}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:92}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: What aileth you that ye speak not?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:93}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:94}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:95}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:96}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:97}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:98}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:99}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:100}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:101}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:102}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ  قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ  سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:103}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:104}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We called to him, "O Abraham,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We called unto him: O Abraham!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:105}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ  إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:106}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:107}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:108}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:109}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: "Peace upon Abraham."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Peace be unto Abraham!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:110}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thus do We reward the good.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:111}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:112}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{37:113}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ  وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 43, Az-Zukhruf (The Ornaments of Gold)
Verses 26 -- 31}

The 63rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{43:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 3, Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran)
Verses 65 -- 68}

The 89th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{3:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O People of the Scripture! Why will ye argue about Abraham, when the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed till after him? Have ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِهِٓ  أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allāh knows, while you know not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! ye are those who argue about that whereof ye have some knowledge: Why then argue ye concerning that whereof ye have no knowledge? Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allāh]. And he was not of the polytheists.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Abraham was not a Jew, nor yet a Christian; but he was an upright man who had surrendered (to Allah), and he was not of the idolaters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allāh] and this prophet [i.e., Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] and those who believe [in his message]. And Allāh is the Ally of the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those of mankind who have the best claim to Abraham are those who followed him, and this Prophet and those who believe (with him); and Allah is the Protecting Guardian of the believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟  وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 124 -- 141}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:124}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (remember) when his Lord tried Abraham with (His) commands, and he fulfilled them, He said: Lo! I have appointed thee a leader for mankind. (Abraham) said: And of my offspring (will there be leaders)? He said: My covenant includeth not wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَإِذِ ٱبْتَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَـٰتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ  قَالَ إِنِّى جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ إِمَامًا  قَالَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى  قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهْدِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:125}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] when We made the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary, (saying): Take as your place of worship the place where Abraham stood (to pray). And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ مُصَلًّى  وَعَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْعَـٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:126}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day." [Allāh] said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Abraham prayed: My Lord! Make this a region of security and bestow upon its people fruits, such of them as believe in Allah and the Last Day, He answered: As for him who disbelieveth, I shall leave him in contentment for a while, then I shall compel him to the doom of Fire - a hapless journey's end!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِـمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا بَلَدًا ءَامِنًا وَٱرْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ مِنْهُم بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ  قَالَ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَأُمَتِّعُهُ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ أَضْطَرُّهُٓ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلنَّارِ  وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:127}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Abraham and Ishmael were raising the foundations of the House, (Abraham prayed): Our Lord! Accept from us (this duty). Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Hearer, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِـمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ  إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:128}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! And make us submissive unto Thee and of our seed a nation submissive unto Thee, and show us our ways of worship, and relent toward us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Relenting, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَا وَٱجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَآ  إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:129}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! And raise up in their midst a messenger from among them who shall recite unto them Thy revelations, and shall instruct them in the Scripture and in wisdom and shall make them grow. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَا وَٱبْعَثْ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ  إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:130}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And who forsaketh the religion of Abraham save him who befooleth himself? Verily We chose him in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he is among the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَرْغَبُ عَن مِّلَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ إِلَّا مَن سَفِهَ نَفْسَهُ  وَلَقَدِ ٱصْطَفَيْنَـٰهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَإِنَّهُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:131}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted [in Islām] to the Lord of the worlds."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When his Lord said unto him: Surrender! he said: I have surrendered to the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ رَبُّهُٓ أَسْلِمْ  قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:132}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allāh has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The same did Abraham enjoin upon his sons, and also Jacob, (saying): O my sons! Lo! Allah hath chosen for you the (true) religion; therefore die not save as men who have surrendered (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَصَّىٰ بِهَآ إِبْرَٰهِـمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ يَـٰبَنِىَّ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:133}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac - one God. And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or were ye present when death came to Jacob, when he said unto his sons: What will ye worship after me? They said: We shall worship thy god, the god of thy fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac, One Allah, and unto Him we have surrendered.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَآءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلْمَوْتُ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن بَعْدِى قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ إِلَـٰهَكَ وَإِلَـٰهَ ءَابَآئِكَ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:134}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those are a people who have passed away. Theirs is that which they earned, and yours is that which ye earn. And ye will not be asked of what they used to do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ  لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ  وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:135}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: Be Jews or Christians, then ye will be rightly guided. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Nay, but (we follow) the religion of Abraham, the upright, and he was not of the idolaters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَـٰرَىٰ تَهْتَدُوا۟  قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ حَنِيفًا  وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:136}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allāh and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants [al-Asbāṭ] and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muslims): We believe in Allah and that which is revealed unto us and that which was revealed unto Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and that which Moses and Jesus received, and that which the prophets received from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and unto Him we have surrendered.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:137}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So if they believe in the same as you believe in, then they have been [rightly] guided; but if they turn away, they are only in dissension, and Allāh will be sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they believe in the like of that which ye believe, then are they rightly guided. But if they turn away, then are they in schism, and Allah will suffice thee (for defence) against them. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِنْ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ مَآ ءَامَنتُم بِهِ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟  وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا هُمْ فِى شِقَاقٍ  فَسَيَكْفِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ  وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:138}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And say, "Ours is] the religion of Allāh. And who is better than Allāh in [ordaining] religion? And we are worshippers of Him."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (We take our) colour from Allah, and who is better than Allah at colouring. We are His worshippers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
صِبْغَةَ ٱللَّهِ  وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ صِبْغَةً  وَنَحْنُ لَهُ عَـٰبِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:139}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Do you argue with us about Allāh while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere [in deed and intention] to Him."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto the People of the Scripture): Dispute ye with us concerning Allah when He is our Lord and your Lord? Ours are our works and yours your works. We look to Him alone.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَتُحَآجُّونَنَا فِى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ وَلَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُخْلِصُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:140}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do you say that Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, "Are you more knowing or is Allāh?" And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony he has from Allāh? And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or say ye that Abraham, and Ishmael, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes were Jews or Christians? Say: Do ye know best, or doth Allah? And who is more unjust than he who hideth a testimony which he hath received from Allah? Allah is not unaware of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ تَقُولُونَ إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِـمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطَ كَانُوا۟ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَـٰرَىٰ  قُلْ ءَأَنتُمْ أَعْلَمُ أَمِ ٱللَّهُ  وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَتَمَ شَهَـٰدَةً عِندَهُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ  وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:141}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those are a people who have passed away; theirs is that which they earned and yours that which ye earn. And ye will not be asked of what they used to do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ  لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ  وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 51, Adh-Dhāriyāt (The Winnowing Winds)
Verses 24 -- 37}

The 67th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{51:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا  قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقَرَّبَهُٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً  قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ  وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: To send down upon them stones of clay,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{51:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 29, Al-`Ankabūt (The Spider)
Verses 16 -- 35}

The 85th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{29:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allāh and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Abraham! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Serve Allah, and keep your duty unto Him; that is better for you if ye did but know.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ  ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You only worship, besides Allāh, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides Allāh do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from Allāh provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ye serve instead of Allah only idols, and ye only invent a lie. Lo! those whom ye serve instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek your provision from Allah, and serve Him, and give thanks unto Him, (for) unto Him ye will be brought back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا  إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَٱبْتَغُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرِّزْقَ وَٱعْبُدُوهُ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لَهُٓ  إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا۟ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ  وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Have they not considered how Allāh begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: See they not how Allah produceth creation, then reproduceth it? Lo! for Allah that is easy.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُٓ  إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then Allāh will produce the final creation [i.e., development]. Indeed Allāh, over all things, is competent."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see how He originated creation, then Allah bringeth forth the later growth. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ  ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He punisheth whom He will and showeth mercy unto whom He will, and unto Him ye will be turned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth or in the heaven. And you have not other than Allāh any protector or any helper.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ye cannot escape (from Him) in the earth or in the sky, and beside Allah there is for you no friend or helper.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ  وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allāh and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who disbelieve in the revelations of Allah and in (their) Meeting with Him, such have no hope of My mercy. For such there is a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham's] people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allāh saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But the answer of his folk was only that they said: "Kill him" or "Burn him." Then Allah saved him from the Fire. Lo! herein verily are portents for folk who believe.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [Abraham] said, "You have only taken, other than Allāh, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Ye have chosen only idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection ye will deny each other and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and ye will have no helpers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْثَـٰنًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا  ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, "Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Lot believed him, and said: Lo! I am a fugitive unto my Lord. Lo! He, only He, is the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ فَـَٔامَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ  وَقَالَ إِنِّى مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّىٓ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave to him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and scripture. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and We established the prophethood and the Scripture among his seed, and We gave him his reward in the world, and lo! in the Hereafter he verily is among the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَجْرَهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَإِنَّهُ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Lo! ye commit lewdness such as no creature did before you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِٓ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{29:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings [every] evil." And the answer of his people was not but that they said, "Bring us the punishment of Allāh, if you should be of the truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For come ye not in unto males, and cut ye not the road (for travellers), and commit ye not abomination in your meetings? But the answer of his folk was only that they said: Bring Allah's doom upon us if thou art a truthteller!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ ٱلسَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِى نَادِيكُمُ ٱلْمُنكَرَ  فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
