\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: A faction of the People of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A party of the People of the Scripture long to make you go astray; and they make none to go astray except themselves, but they perceive not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allāh while you witness [to their truth]?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O People of the Scripture! Why disbelieve ye in the revelations of Allah, when ye (yourselves) bear witness (to their truth)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O People of the Scripture, why do you mix [i.e., confuse] the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O People of the Scripture! Why confound ye truth with falsehood and knowingly conceal the truth?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will return [i.e., abandon their religion],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And a party of the People of the Scripture say: Believe in that which hath been revealed unto those who believe at the opening of the day, and disbelieve at the end thereof, in order that they may return;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allāh. [Do you fear] lest someone be given [knowledge] like you were given or that they would [thereby] argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And believe not save in one who followeth your religion - Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the guidance is Allah's Guidance - that anyone is given the like of that which was given unto you or that they may argue with you in the presence of their Lord. Say (O Muhammad): Lo! the bounty is in Allah's hand. He bestoweth it on whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ  قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He selecteth for His mercy whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know [it].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Among the People of the Scripture there is he who, if thou trust him with a weight of treasure, will return it to thee. And among them there is he who, if thou trust him with a piece of gold, will not return it to thee unless thou keep standing over him. That is because they say: We have no duty to the Gentiles. They speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًا  ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـنَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allāh - then indeed, Allāh loves those who fear Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but (the chosen of Allah is) he who fulfilleth his pledge and wardeth off (evil); for lo! Allah loveth those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allāh and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allāh will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who purchase a small gain at the cost of Allah's covenant and their oaths, they have no portion in the Hereafter. Allah will neither speak to them nor look upon them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He make them grow. Theirs will be a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَـٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allāh," but it is not from Allāh. And they speak untruth about Allāh while they know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! there is a party of them who distort the Scripture with their tongues, that ye may think that what they say is from the Scripture, when it is not from the Scripture. And they say: It is from Allah, when it is not from Allah; and they speak a lie concerning Allah knowingly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًا يَلْوُنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allāh should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, "Be servants to me rather than Allāh," but [instead, he would say], "Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not (possible) for any human being unto whom Allah had given the Scripture and wisdom and the prophethood that he should afterwards have said unto mankind: Be slaves of me instead of Allah; but (what he said was): Be ye faithful servants of the Lord by virtue of your constant teaching of the Scripture and of your constant study thereof.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّـٰنِيِّـنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Nor could he order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had been Muslims?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he commanded you not that ye should take the angels and the prophets for lords. Would he command you to disbelieve after ye had surrendered (to Allah)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ أَرْبَابًا  أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allāh took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allāh] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged it." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When Allah made (His) covenant with the prophets, (He said): Behold that which I have given you of the Scripture and knowledge. And afterward there will come unto you a messenger, confirming that which ye possess. Ye shall believe in him and ye shall help him. He said: Do ye agree, and will ye take up My burden (which I lay upon you) in this (matter)? They answered: We agree. He said: Then bear ye witness. I will be a witness with you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَـٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَـٰبٍ وَحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُ  قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ إِصْرِى  قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا  قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then whosoever after this shall turn away: they will be miscreants.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{3:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So is it other than the religion of Allāh they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Seek they other than the religion of Allah, when unto Him submitteth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and unto Him they will be returned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 72, Al-Jinn (The Jinn)
All Verses (1 -- 28)}

The 40th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{72:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِ  وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ  فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ  كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِ  فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ  فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ  وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِٓ أَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِ  وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِٓ أَحَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{72:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That he [i.e., Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 4}
\section{Surah 53, An-Najm (The Star)
All Verses (1 -- 62)}

The 23rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{53:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: By the star when it descends,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By the Star when it setteth,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not but a revelation revealed,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

\textit{M. Pickthall}: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he approached and descended

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he drew nigh and came down

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he certainly saw him in another descent

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily he saw him yet another time

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The sight [of the Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Manāt, the third - the other one?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Manat, the third, the other?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Are yours the males and His the females?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That, then, is an unjust division.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That indeed were an unfair division!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ  إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ  وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or shall man have what he coveteth?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ  إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ  وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ  إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ  إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ  هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ  فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ  هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Have you seen the one who turned away

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And gave a little, then was grudging?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Abraham who paid his debt:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That no laden one shall bear another's load,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that his effort is going to be seen -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that his effort will be seen.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that to your Lord is the finality

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

\textit{M. Pickthall}: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنَّهُٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the overturned towns He hurled down

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And covered them by that which He covered.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So that there covered them that which did cover.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: This [Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is a warner of the warners of old.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Approaching Day has approached.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The threatened Hour is nigh.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: None beside Allah can disclose it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then at this statement do you wonder?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Marvel ye then at this statement,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you laugh and do not weep

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And laugh and not weep,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: While you are proudly sporting?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: While ye amuse yourselves?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{53:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 14, Ibrāhīm (Abraham)
Verses 1 -- 4}

The 72nd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{14:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture which We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) that thereby thou mayst bring forth mankind from darkness unto light, by the permission of their Lord, unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 الٓر  كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ ٱلنَّاسَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe [i.e., destruction] to the disbelievers from a severe punishment -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. and woe unto the disbelievers from an awful doom;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who love the life of the world more than the Hereafter, and debar (men) from the way of Allah and would have it crooked: such are far astray.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا عَلَى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{14:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We never sent a messenger save with the language of his folk, that he might make (the message) clear for them. Then Allah sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ  فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ  وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 10, Yūnus (Jonah)
Verses 37 -- 70}

The 51st revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{10:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it was not [possible] for this Qur’ān to be produced by other than Allāh, but [it is] a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of the [former] Scripture, about which there is no doubt, from the Lord of the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And this Qur'an is not such as could ever be invented in despite of Allah; but it is a confirmation of that which was before it and an exposition of that which is decreed for mankind - Therein is no doubt - from the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كَانَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ ٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they say [about the Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))], "He invented it?" Say, "Then bring forth a sūrah like it and call upon [for assistance] whomever you can besides Allāh, if you should be truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say: Then bring a surah like unto it, and call (for help) on all ye can besides Allah, if ye are truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ  قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّثْلِهِ وَٱدْعُوا۟ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, they have denied that which they encompass not in knowledge and whose interpretation has not yet come to them. Thus did those before them deny. Then observe how was the end of the wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but they denied that, the knowledge whereof they could not compass, and whereof the interpretation (in events) hath not yet come unto them. Even so did those before them deny. Then see what was the consequence for the wrong-doers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِمَا لَمْ يُحِيطُوا۟ بِعِلْمِهِ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِهِمْ تَأْوِيلُهُ  كَذَٰلِكَ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ  فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And of them is he who believeth therein, and of them is he who believeth not therein, and thy Lord is Best Aware of the corrupters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنْهُم مَّن يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ  وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they deny thee, say: Unto me my work, and unto you your work. Ye are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّى عَمَلِى وَلَكُمْ عَمَلُكُمْ  أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعْمَلُ وَأَنَا بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And among them are those who listen to you. But can you cause the deaf to hear [i.e., benefit from this hearing], although they will not use reason?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And of them are some who listen unto thee. But canst thou make the deaf to hear even though they apprehend not?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ  أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And of them is he who looketh toward thee. But canst thou guide the blind even though they see not?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ  أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh does not wrong the people at all, but it is the people who are wronging themselves.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah wrongeth not mankind in aught; but mankind wrong themselves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And on the Day when He will gather them, [it will be] as if they had not remained [in the world] but an hour of the day, [and] they will know each other. Those will have lost who denied the meeting with Allāh and were not guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And on the day when He shall gather them together, (when it will seem) as though they had tarried but an hour of the day, recognising one another, those will verily have perished who denied the meeting with Allah and were not guided.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ كَأَن لَّمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّنَ ٱلنَّهَارِ يَتَعَارَفُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ  قَدْ خَسِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whether We show you some of what We promise them, [O Muḥammad], or We take you in death, to Us is their return; then, [either way], Allāh is a witness concerning what they are doing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whether We let thee (O Muhammad) behold something of that which We promise them or (whether We) cause thee to die, still unto Us is their return, and Allah, moreover, is Witness over what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, it will be judged between them in justice, and they will not be wronged.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And for every nation there is a messenger. And when their messenger cometh (on the Day of Judgment) it will be judged between them fairly, and they will not be wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولٌ  فَإِذَا جَآءَ رَسُولُهُمْ قُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "I possess not for myself any harm or benefit except what Allāh should will. For every nation is a [specified] term. When their time has come, then they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: I have no power to hurt or benefit myself, save that which Allah willeth. For every nation there is an appointed time. When their time cometh, then they cannot put it off an hour, nor hasten (it).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لَّآ أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِى ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ  لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلٌ  إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً  وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Have you considered: if His punishment should come to you by night or by day - for which [aspect] of it would the criminals be impatient?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Have ye thought: When His doom cometh unto you as a raid by night, or in the (busy) day; what is there of it that the guilty ones desire to hasten?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَىٰكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَـٰتًا أَوْ نَهَارًا مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then is it that when it has [actually] occurred you will believe in it? Now? And you were [once] for it impatient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is it (only) then, when it hath befallen you, that ye will believe? What! (Believe) now, when (until now) ye have been hastening it on (through disbelief)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَثُمَّ إِذَا مَا وَقَعَ ءَامَنتُم بِهِٓ  ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then it will be said to those who had wronged, "Taste the punishment of eternity; are you being recompensed except for what you used to earn?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then will it be said unto those who dealt unjustly Taste the torment of eternity. Are ye requited aught save what ye used to earn?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ قِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they ask information of you, [O Muḥammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allāh]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they ask thee to inform them (saying): Is it true? Say: Yea, by my Lord, verily it is true, and ye cannot escape.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَيَسْتَنبِـُٔونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ  قُلْ إِى وَرَبِّىٓ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ  وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if each soul that wronged had everything on earth, it would offer it in ransom. And they will confide regret when they see the punishment; and they will be judged in justice, and they will not be wronged.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if each soul that doeth wrong had all that is in the earth it would seek to ransom itself therewith; and they will feel remorse within them, when they see the doom. But it hath been judged between them fairly and they are not wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِكُلِّ نَفْسٍ ظَلَمَتْ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَٱفْتَدَتْ بِهِ  وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ  وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ  وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Unquestionably, the promise of Allāh is truth, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! verily all that is in the heavens and the earth is Allah's. Lo! verily Allah's promise is true. But most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  أَلَآ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He gives life and causes death, and to Him you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He quickeneth and giveth death, and unto Him ye will be returned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O mankind, there has come to you instruction from your Lord and healing for what is in the breasts and guidance and mercy for the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O mankind! There hath come unto you an exhortation from your Lord, a balm for that which is in the breasts, a guidance and a mercy for believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "In the bounty of Allāh and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice; it is better than what they accumulate."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: In the bounty of Allah and in His mercy: therein let them rejoice. It is better than what they hoard.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا۟ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Have you seen what Allāh has sent down to you of provision of which you have made [some] lawful and [some] unlawful?" Say, "Has Allāh permitted you [to do so], or do you invent [something] about Allāh?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Have ye considered what provision Allah hath sent down for you, how ye have made of it lawful and unlawful? Hath Allah permitted you, or do ye invent a lie concerning Allah?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ فَجَعَلْتُم مِّنْهُ حَرَامًا وَحَلَـٰلًا قُلْ ءَآللَّهُ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ  أَمْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَفْتَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And what will be the supposition of those who invent falsehood about Allāh on the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And what think those who invent a lie concerning Allah (will be their plight) upon the Day of Resurrection? Lo! Allah truly is Bountiful toward mankind, but most of them give not thanks.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And, [O Muḥammad], you are not [engaged] in any matter and do not recite any of the Qur’ān and you [people] do not do any deed except that We are witness over you when you are involved in it. And not absent from your Lord is any [part] of an atom's weight within the earth or within the heaven or [anything] smaller than that or greater but that it is in a clear register.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou (Muhammad) art not occupied with any business and thou recitest not a Lecture from this (Scripture), and ye (mankind) perform no act, but We are Witness of you when ye are engaged therein. And not an atom's weight in the earth or in the sky escapeth your Lord, nor what is less than that or greater than that, but it is (written) in a clear Book.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا تَكُونُ فِى شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُوا۟ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْءَانٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ  وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَآ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْبَرَ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allāh there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! verily the friends of Allah are (those) on whom fear (cometh) not, nor do they grieve?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَآ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who believed and were fearing Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who believe and keep their duty (to Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For them are good tidings in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. No change is there in the words [i.e., decrees] of Allāh. That is what is the great attainment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Theirs are good tidings in the life of the world and in the Hereafter - There is no changing the Words of Allah - that is the Supreme Triumph.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ  لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ  ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, honor [due to power] belongs to Allāh entirely. He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! power belongeth wholly to Allah. He is the Hearer, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا  هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth. And those who invoke other than Allāh do not [actually] follow [His] "partners." They follow not except assumption, and they are not but misjudging.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! is it not unto Allah that belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth? Those who follow aught instead of Allah follow not (His) partners. They follow only a conjecture, and they do but guess.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  وَمَا يَتَّبِعُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ  إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He it is Who hath appointed for you the night that ye should rest therein and the day giving sight. Lo! herein verily are portents for a folk that heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have said, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They say: Allah hath taken (unto Him) a son - Glorified be He! He hath no needs! His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Ye have no warrant for this. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًا  سُبْحَـٰنَهُ  هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ  لَهُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ بِهَـٰذَآ  أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allāh will not succeed."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Verily those who invent a lie concerning Allah will not succeed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{10:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [For them is brief] enjoyment in this world; then to Us is their return; then We will make them taste the severe punishment because they used to disbelieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This world's portion (will be theirs), then unto Us is their return. Then We make them taste a dreadful doom because they used to disbelieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَتَـٰعٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ نُذِيقُهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلشَّدِيدَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 74, Al-Muddaththir (The Cloaked One)
All Verses (1 -- 56)}

The 4th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{74:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Arise and warn

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Arise and warn!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And your Lord glorify

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thy Lord magnify,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And your clothing purify

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thy raiment purify,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And uncleanliness avoid

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Pollution shun!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not confer favor to acquire more

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But for your Lord be patient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when the trumpet is blown,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For when the trumpet shall sound,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Day will be a difficult day

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For the disbelievers - not easy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Not of ease, for disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Leave Me with the one I created alone

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And then bestowed upon him ample means,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And children present [with him]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And sons abiding in his presence

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And made (life) smooth for him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he desires that I should add more.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Yet he desireth that I should give more.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّآ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: I will cover him with arduous torment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he considered [again];

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then looked he,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he frowned and scowled;

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then he turned back and was arrogant

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then turned he away in pride

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: This is not but the word of a human being."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: I will drive him into Saqar.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Him shall I fling unto the burning.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It shrivelleth the man.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Over it are nineteen [angels].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Above it are nineteen.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً  وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا  وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ  وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا  كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ  وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ  وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! By the moon

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, by the Moon

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [by] the night when it departs

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the night when it withdraweth

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the dawn when it shineth forth,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: As a warning to humanity -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As a warning unto men,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except the companions of the right,.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save those who will stand on the right hand.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

\textit{M. Pickthall}: In gardens they will ask one another

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: About the criminals,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Concerning the guilty:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: What hath brought you to this burning?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nor did we feed the wretched.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Till the Inevitable came unto us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: As if they were alarmed donkeys

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As they were frightened asses

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Fleeing from a lion?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Fleeing from a lion?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّا  بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّآ إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then whoever wills will remember it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So whosoever will may heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{74:56}]
