\textit{M. Pickthall}: He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِى لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ  فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ  لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا  وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ  وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ  كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ  كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا بُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا  وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ  وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ  وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا  لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ  وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{25:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى  وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 13, Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder)
Verses 30 -- 33}

The 96th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{13:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thus We send thee (O Muhammad) unto a nation, before whom other nations have passed away, that thou mayst recite unto them that which We have inspired in thee, while they are disbelievers in the Beneficent. Say: He is my Lord; there is no Allah save Him. In Him do I put my trust and unto Him is my recourse.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ فِىٓ أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَآ أُمَمٌ لِّتَتْلُوَا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ  قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{13:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had it been possible for a Lecture to cause the mountains to move, or the earth to be torn asunder, or the dead to speak, (this Qur'an would have done so). Nay, but Allah's is the whole command. Do not those who believe know that, had Allah willed, He could have guided all mankind? As for those who disbelieve, disaster ceaseth not to strike them because of what they do, or it dwelleth near their home until the threat of Allah come to pass. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْءَانًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ ٱلْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ  بَل لِّلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا  أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا  وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا۟ قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ وَعْدُ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{13:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily messengers (of Allah) were mocked before thee, but long I bore with those who disbelieved. At length I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ  فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{13:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is He Who is aware of the deserts of every soul (as he who is aware of nothing)? Yet they ascribe unto Allah partners. Say: Name them. Is it that ye would inform Him of something which He knoweth not in the earth? Or is it but a way of speaking? Nay but their contrivance is made seeming fair for those who disbelieve and they are kept from the right road. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ  وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ  أَمْ تُنَبِّـُٔونَهُ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَـٰهِرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ  بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ  وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 34, Saba (Sheba)
Verses 43 -- 50}

The 58th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{34:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, they say, "This is not but a man who wishes to avert you from that which your fathers were worshipping." And they say, "This is not except a lie invented." And those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is not but obvious magic."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى  وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We had not given them any scriptures which they could study, and We had not sent to them before you, [O Muḥammad], any warner.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have given them no scriptures which they study, nor sent We unto them, before thee, any warner.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا  وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those before them denied, and they [i.e., the people of Makkah] have not attained a tenth of what We had given them. But they [i.e., the former peoples] denied My messengers, so how [terrible] was My reproach.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى  فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "I only advise you of one [thing] - that you stand for Allāh, [seeking truth] in pairs and individually, and then give thought." There is not in your companion any madness. He is only a warner to you before a severe punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ  أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟  مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ  إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Whatever payment I might have asked of you - it is yours. My payment is only from Allāh, and He is, over all things, Witness."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ  إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ  وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, my Lord projects the truth, Knower of the unseen."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "If I should err, I would only err against myself. But if I am guided, it is by what my Lord reveals to me. Indeed, He is Hearing and near."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى  وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ  إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 17, Al-'Isrā (The Night Journey)
Verses 105 -- 111}

The 50th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{17:105}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: With truth have We sent it down, and with truth hath it descended. And We have sent thee as naught else save a bearer of good tidings and a warner.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ  وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:106}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:107}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Believe therein or believe not, lo! those who were given knowledge before it, when it is read unto them, fall down prostrate on their faces, adoring,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:108}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Saying: Glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:109}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They fall down on their faces, weeping, and it increaseth humility in them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًا ۩
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:110}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto mankind): Cry unto Allah, or cry unto the Beneficent, unto whichsoever ye cry (it is the same). His are the most beautiful names. And thou (Muhammad), be not loud-voiced in thy worship nor yet silent therein, but follow a way between.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ  أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ  وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:111}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And say, "Praise to Allāh, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath not taken unto Himself a son, and Who hath no partner in the Sovereignty, nor hath He any protecting friend through dependence. And magnify Him with all magnificence.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِىٌّ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ  وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 5}
\section{Surah 55, Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent)
Verses 1 -- 30}

The 97th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{55:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Most Merciful

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Beneficent

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Taught the Qur’ān,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath made known the Qur'an.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Created man,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He hath created man.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And] taught him eloquence.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He hath taught him utterance.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The sun and the moon are made punctual.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the stars and trees prostrate.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The stars and the trees prostrate.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That you not transgress within the balance.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That ye exceed not the measure,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And grain having husks and scented plants.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Husked grain and scented herb.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He created man of clay like the potter's,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَسْـَٔلُهُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{55:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 17, Al-'Isrā (The Night Journey)
Verses 45 -- 54}

The 50th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{17:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you recite the Qur’ān, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thou recitest the Qur'an we place between thee and those who believe not in the Hereafter a hidden barrier;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We place upon their hearts veils lest they should understand it, and in their ears a deafness; and when thou makest mention of thy Lord alone in the Qur'an, they turn their backs in aversion.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا  وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَـٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We are Best Aware of what they wish to hear when they give ear to thee and when they take secret counsel, when the evil-doers say: Ye follow but a man bewitched.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: See what similitudes they coin for thee, and thus are all astray, and cannot find a road!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: When we are bones and fragments, shall we forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا وَرُفَـٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Be you stones or iron

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Be ye stones or iron

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts." And they will say, "Who will restore us?" Say, "He who brought you forth the first time." Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, "When is that?" Say, "Perhaps it will be soon -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ  فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا  قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ  فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ  قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A day when He will call you and ye will answer with His praise, and ye will think that ye have tarried but a little while.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to mankind, a clear enemy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ  إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a manager.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Your Lord is Best Aware of you. If He will, He will have mercy on you, or if He will, He will punish you. We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) as a warden over them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ  إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ  وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 19, Maryam (Mary)
All Verses (1 -- 98)}

The 44th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{19:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ʿAyn, Ṣād.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 كٓهيعٓصٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُ زَكَرِيَّآ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُن بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ  وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًٔا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً  قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allāh] in the morning and afternoon.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ  وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allāh

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةً  وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَرًّا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allāh."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًا زَكِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.'"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ  وَلِنَجْعَلَهُٓ ءَايَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةً مِّنَّا  وَكَانَ أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِ مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًا مَّنسِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَـٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًا  فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ  قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًٔا فَرِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O sister [i.e., descendant] of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأُخْتَ هَـٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ  قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allāh. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَـٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَرًّا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًا شَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ  قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ  سُبْحَـٰنَهُٓ  إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ  هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ  فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا  لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ  إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ  لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ  وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ  سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ  وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We raised him to a high station.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We raised him to high station.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ  إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ  فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُ بِٱلْغَيْبِ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا  وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ  لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ  وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِ  هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا  كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا  حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى  وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّا  سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَلَّا  سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ  إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{19:87}]
