وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ  أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ  وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً  وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ  سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ  بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا  لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ  أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ  أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ  وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا  وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا  وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ  أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ  أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً  وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ  وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ  إِنَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ  وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا  وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ  وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّن بَأْسِكُمْ  فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا  وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ  وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ  وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ  كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ  إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ  وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:89}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:90}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُٓ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا  وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:91}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:92}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:93}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ  كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:94}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَـٰتِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:95}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:96}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:97}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:98}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:99}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا  وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:100}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:101}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:102}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا  وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:103}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:104}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ  كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُ  وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ  إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:105}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِن بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:106}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:107}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:108}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ  فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:109}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ  وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:110}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:111}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{21:112}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [The Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ  وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 26, Ash-Shu`arā (The Poets)
Verses 141 -- 159}

The 47th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{26:141}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Thamūd denied the messengers

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:142}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:143}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:144}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So fear Allāh and obey me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:145}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ  إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:146}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:147}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Within gardens and springs

\textit{M. Pickthall}: In gardens and watersprings.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:148}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:149}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:150}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So fear Allāh and obey me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:151}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And obey not the command of the prodigal,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:152}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:153}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:154}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:155}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:156}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:157}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:158}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً  وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{26:159}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 43, Az-Zukhruf (The Ornaments of Gold)
All Verses (1 -- 89)}

The 63rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{43:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Ḥā, Meem.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ha. Mim.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 حمٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: By the clear Book,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By the Scripture which maketh plain,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّهُ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا  كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِتَسْتَوُا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا  إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا  أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ  سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم  مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ  إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ  قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ  فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ  نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا  وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَزُخْرُفًا  وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ  إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ  وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا  وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ  أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ  مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا  بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ  هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ  إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ  فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ  هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ  فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ  وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ  وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ  قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم  بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ  وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ  فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقِيلِهِ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{43:89}]
