\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ  فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 22, Al-Ĥajj (The Pilgrimage)
Verses 52 -- 57}

The 103rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{22:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ  وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ  وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ  فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 44, Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke)
All Verses (1 -- 59)}

The 64th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{44:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Ḥā, Meem.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ha. Mim.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 حمٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: By the clear Book,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By the Scripture that maketh plain

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ  إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whereon every wise command is made clear

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ  إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ  إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِ وَيُمِيتُ  رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but they play in doubt.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ  هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا  إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ  إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ  إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا  إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And crops and noble sites

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And comfort wherein they were amused.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَذَٰلِكَ  وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مِن فِرْعَوْنَ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ  أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ  إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Is food for the sinful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The food of the sinner!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Like the boiling of scalding water.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As the seething of boiling water.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Within gardens and springs,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Amid gardens and watersprings,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ  وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ  ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{44:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 6}
\section{Surah 28, Al-Qaşaş (The Stories)
Verses 44 -- 56}

The 49th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{28:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you, [O Muḥammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou (Muhammad) wast not on the western side (of the Mount) when We expounded unto Moses the commandment, and thou wast not among those present;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلْغَرْبِىِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَى ٱلْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But We brought forth generations, and their lives dragged on for them. And thou wast not a dweller in Midian, reciting unto them Our revelations, but We kept sending (messengers to men).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَـٰكِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ  وَمَا كُنتَ ثَاوِيًا فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou was not beside the Mount when We did call; but (the knowledge of it is) a mercy from thy Lord that thou mayst warn a folk unto whom no warner came before thee, that haply they may give heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كُنتَ بِجَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِن رَّحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Otherwise, if disaster should afflict them because of that which their own hands have sent before (them), they might say: Our Lord! Why sentest Thou no messenger unto us, that we might have followed Thy revelations and been of the believers?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَآ أَن تُصِيبَهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But when there came unto them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Why is he not given the like of what was given unto Moses? Did they not disbelieve in that which was given unto Moses of old? They say: Two magics that support each other; and they say: Lo! in both we are disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُوتِىَ مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰٓ  أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ  قَالُوا۟ سِحْرَانِ تَظَـٰهَرَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allāh which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Then bring a scripture from the presence of Allah that giveth clearer guidance than these two (that) I may follow it, if ye are truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَآ أَتَّبِعْهُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allāh? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they answer thee not, then know that what they follow is their lusts. And who goeth farther astray than he who followeth his lust without guidance from Allah. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِن لَّمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَكَ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ  وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًى مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And now verily We have caused the Word to reach them, that haply they may give heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture before it, they believe in it,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِهِ هُم بِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when it is recited unto them, they say: We believe in it. Lo! it is the Truth from our Lord. Lo! even before it we were of those who surrender (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِٓ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلِهِ مُسْلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: These will be given their reward twice over, because they are steadfast and repel evil with good, and spend of that wherewith We have provided them,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُم مَّرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when they hear vanity they withdraw from it and say: Unto us our works and unto you your works. Peace be unto you! We desire not the ignorant.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ لَنَآ أَعْمَـٰلُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِى ٱلْجَـٰهِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{28:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, [O Muḥammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allāh guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! thou (O Muhammad) guidest not whom thou lovest, but Allah guideth whom He will. And He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ  وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 5, Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread)
Verses 11 -- 84}

The 112th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{5:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when a people determined to extend their hands [in aggression] against you, but He withheld their hands from you; and fear Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you, how a people were minded to stretch out their hands against you but He withheld their hands from you; and keep your duty to Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَن يَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ  وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh had already taken a covenant from the Children of Israel, and We delegated from among them twelve leaders. And Allāh said, "I am with you. If you establish prayer and give zakāh and believe in My messengers and support them and loan Allāh a goodly loan, I will surely remove from you your misdeeds and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever of you disbelieves after that has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah made a covenant of old with the Children of Israel and We raised among them twelve chieftains, and Allah said: Lo! I am with you. If ye establish worship and pay the poor-due, and believe in My messengers and support them, and lend unto Allah a kindly loan, surely I shall remit your sins, and surely I shall bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Whoso among you disbelieveth after this will go astray from a plain road.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَـٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَبَعَثْنَا مِنْهُمُ ٱثْنَىْ عَشَرَ نَقِيبًا  وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ  لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَيْتُمُ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَءَامَنتُم بِرُسُلِى وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا لَّأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ  فَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So for their breaking of the covenant We cursed them and made their hearts hardened. They distort words from their [proper] places [i.e., usages] and have forgotten a portion of that of which they were reminded. And you will still observe deceit among them, except a few of them. But pardon them and overlook [their misdeeds]. Indeed, Allāh loves the doers of good.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And because of their breaking their covenant, We have cursed them and made hard their hearts. They change words from their context and forget a part of that whereof they were admonished. Thou wilt not cease to discover treachery from all save a few of them. But bear with them and pardon them. Lo! Allah loveth the kindly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَـٰقَهُمْ لَعَنَّـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا قُلُوبَهُمْ قَـٰسِيَةً  يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ عَن مَّوَاضِعِهِ  وَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِ  وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَىٰ خَآئِنَةٍ مِّنْهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ  فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱصْفَحْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And from those who say, "We are Christians" We took their covenant; but they forgot a portion of that of which they were reminded. So We caused among them animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. And Allāh is going to inform them about what they used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And with those who say: "Lo! we are Christians," We made a covenant, but they forgot a part of that whereof they were admonished. Therefor We have stirred up enmity and hatred among them till the Day of Resurrection, when Allah will inform them of their handiwork.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَـٰرَىٰٓ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَهُمْ فَنَسُوا۟ حَظًّا مِّمَّا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهِ فَأَغْرَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَاوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ  وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger making clear to you much of what you used to conceal of the Scripture and overlooking much. There has come to you from Allāh a light and a clear Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O People of the Scripture! Now hath Our messenger come unto you, expounding unto you much of that which ye used to hide in the Scripture, and forgiving much. now hath come unto you light from Allah and plain Scripture,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا كُنتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَن كَثِيرٍ  قَدْ جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ نُورٌ وَكِتَـٰبٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: By which Allāh guides those who pursue His pleasure to the ways of peace and brings them out from darknesses into the light, by His permission, and guides them to a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whereby Allah guideth him who seeketh His good pleasure unto paths of peace. He bringeth them out of darkness unto light by His decree, and guideth them unto a straight path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَهْدِى بِهِ ٱللَّهُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَهُ سُبُلَ ٱلسَّلَـٰمِ وَيُخْرِجُهُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have certainly disbelieved who say that Allāh is Christ, the son of Mary. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He had intended to destroy Christ, the son of Mary, or his mother or everyone on the earth?" And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. He creates what He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They indeed have disbelieved who say: Lo! Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary. Say: Who then can do aught against Allah, if He had willed to destroy the Messiah son of Mary, and his mother and everyone on earth? Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He createth what He will. And Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ  قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُهْلِكَ ٱلْمَسِيحَ ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا  وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا  يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But the Jews and the Christians say, "We are the children of Allāh and His beloved." Say, "Then why does He punish you for your sins?" Rather, you are human beings from among those He has created. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the [final] destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Jews and Christians say: We are sons of Allah and His loved ones. Say: Why then doth He chastise you for your sins? Nay, ye are but mortals of His creating. He forgiveth whom He will, and chastiseth whom He will. Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and unto Him is the journeying.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ نَحْنُ أَبْنَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّـٰٓؤُهُ  قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُم بِذُنُوبِكُم  بَلْ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ  يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا  وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger to make clear to you [the religion] after a period [of suspension] of messengers, lest you say, "There came not to us any bringer of good tidings or a warner." But there has come to you a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And Allāh is over all things competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O People of the Scripture! Now hath Our messenger come unto you to make things plain unto you after an interval (of cessation) of the messengers, lest ye should say: There came not unto us a messenger of cheer nor any warner. Now hath a messenger of cheer and a warner come unto you. Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ قَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولُنَا يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ عَلَىٰ فَتْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا جَآءَنَا مِن بَشِيرٍ وَلَا نَذِيرٍ  فَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بَشِيرٌ وَنَذِيرٌ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when He appointed among you prophets and made you possessors and gave you that which He had not given anyone among the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Remember Allah's favour unto you, how He placed among you prophets, and He made you kings, and gave you that (which) He gave not to any (other) of (His) creatures.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنبِيَآءَ وَجَعَلَكُم مُّلُوكًا وَءَاتَىٰكُم مَّا لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَدًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O my people! Go into the holy land which Allah hath ordained for you. Turn not in flight, for surely ye turn back as losers:

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "O Moses, indeed within it is a people of tyrannical strength, and indeed, we will never enter it until they leave it; but if they leave it, then we will enter."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: O Moses! Lo! a giant people (dwell) therein and lo! we go not in till they go forth from thence. When they go forth from thence, then we will enter (not till then).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ فِيهَا قَوْمًا جَبَّارِينَ وَإِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا حَتَّىٰ يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّا دَٰخِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Said two men from those who feared [to disobey] upon whom Allāh had bestowed favor, "Enter upon them through the gate, for when you have entered it, you will be predominant. And upon Allāh rely, if you should be believers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then out spake two of those who feared (their Lord, men) unto whom Allah had been gracious: Enter in upon them by the gate, for if ye enter by it, lo! ye will be victorious. So put your trust (in Allah) if ye are indeed believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ رَجُلَانِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْبَابَ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ فَإِنَّكُمْ غَـٰلِبُونَ  وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "O Moses, indeed we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are within it; so go, you and your Lord, and fight. Indeed, we are remaining right here."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: O Moses! We will never enter (the land) while they are in it. So go thou and thy Lord and fight! We will sit here.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَآ أَبَدًا مَّا دَامُوا۟ فِيهَا  فَٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَـٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَـٰهُنَا قَـٰعِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Moses] said, "My Lord, indeed I do not possess [i.e., control] except myself and my brother, so part us from the defiantly disobedient people."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: My Lord! I have control of none but myself and my brother, so distinguish between us and the wrong-doing folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ إِلَّا نَفْسِى وَأَخِى  فَٱفْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Allāh] said, "Then indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years [in which] they will wander throughout the land. So do not grieve over the defiantly disobedient people."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Their Lord) said: For this the land will surely be forbidden them for forty years that they will wander in the earth, bewildered. So grieve not over the wrongdoing folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ  أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً  يَتِيهُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But recite unto them with truth the tale of the two sons of Adam, how they offered each a sacrifice, and it was accepted from the one of them and it was not accepted from the other. (The one) said: I will surely kill thee. (The other) answered: Allah accepteth only from those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ  قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If you should raise your hand toward me to kill me - I shall not raise my hand toward you to kill you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Even if thou stretch out thy hand against me to kill me, I shall not stretch out my hand against thee to kill thee, lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَئِن بَسَطتَ إِلَىَّ يَدَكَ لِتَقْتُلَنِى مَآ أَنَا بِبَاسِطٍ يَدِىَ إِلَيْكَ لِأَقْتُلَكَ  إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, I want you to obtain [thereby] my sin and your sin so you will be among the companions of the Fire. And that is the recompense of wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! I would rather thou shouldst bear the punishment of the sin against me and thine own sin and become one of the owners of the fire. That is the reward of evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنِّىٓ أُرِيدُ أَن تَبُوٓأَ بِإِثْمِى وَإِثْمِكَ فَتَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ  وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But (the other's) mind imposed on him the killing of his brother, so he slew him and became one of the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُ نَفْسُهُ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then Allāh sent a crow searching [i.e., scratching] in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the disgrace [i.e., body] of my brother?" And he became of the regretful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then Allah sent a raven scratching up the ground, to show him how to hide his brother's naked corpse. He said: Woe unto me! Am I not able to be as this raven and so hide my brother's naked corpse? And he became repentant.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَٰرِى سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ  قَالَ يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْغُرَابِ فَأُوَٰرِىَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِى  فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلنَّـٰدِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Because of that, We decreed upon the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption [done] in the land - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely. And Our messengers had certainly come to them with clear proofs. Then indeed many of them, [even] after that, throughout the land, were transgressors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For that cause We decreed for the Children of Israel that whosoever killeth a human being for other than manslaughter or corruption in the earth, it shall be as if he had killed all mankind, and whoso saveth the life of one, it shall be as if he had saved the life of all mankind. Our messengers came unto them of old with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but afterwards lo! many of them became prodigals in the earth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا  وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the penalty for those who wage war against Allāh and His Messenger and strive upon earth [to cause] corruption is none but that they be killed or crucified or that their hands and feet be cut off from opposite sides or that they be exiled from the land. That is for them a disgrace in this world; and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The only reward of those who make war upon Allah and His messenger and strive after corruption in the land will be that they will be killed or crucified, or have their hands and feet on alternate sides cut off, or will be expelled out of the land. Such will be their degradation in the world, and in the Hereafter theirs will be an awful doom;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَارِبُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا أَن يُقَتَّلُوٓا۟ أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوٓا۟ أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ أَوْ يُنفَوْا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ  ذَٰلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْىٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except for those who return [repenting] before you overcome [i.e., apprehend] them. And know that Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save those who repent before ye overpower them. For know that Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ  فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah, and seek the way of approach unto Him, and strive in His way in order that ye may succeed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who disbelieve - if they should have all that is in the earth and the like of it with it by which to ransom themselves from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection, it will not be accepted from them, and for them is a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for those who disbelieve, lo! if all that is in the earth were theirs, and as much again therewith, to ransom them from the doom on the Day of Resurrection, it would not be accepted from them. Theirs will be a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لِيَفْتَدُوا۟ بِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ مَا تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ  وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will wish to get out of the Fire, but never are they to emerge therefrom, and for them is an enduring punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They will wish to come forth from the Fire, but they will not come forth from it. Theirs will be a lasting doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَـٰرِجِينَ مِنْهَا  وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [As for] the thief, the male and the female, amputate their hands in recompense for what they earned [i.e., committed] as a deterrent [punishment] from Allāh. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for the thief, both male and female, cut off their hands. It is the reward of their own deeds, an exemplary punishment from Allah. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلسَّارِقُ وَٱلسَّارِقَةُ فَٱقْطَعُوٓا۟ أَيْدِيَهُمَا جَزَآءً بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَـٰلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, indeed, Allāh will turn to him in forgiveness. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But whoso repenteth after his wrongdoing and amendeth, lo! Allah will relent toward him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَمَن تَابَ مِن بَعْدِ ظُلْمِهِ وَأَصْلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do you not know that to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whom He wills and forgives whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Knowest thou not that unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth? He punisheth whom He will, and forgiveth whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Messenger, let them not grieve you who hasten into disbelief – of those who say, "We believe" with their mouths, but their hearts believe not, and from among the Jews. [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, listening to another people who have not come to you. They distort words beyond their [proper] places [i.e., usages], saying, "If you are given this, take it; but if you are not given it, then beware." But he for whom Allāh intends fitnah - never will you possess [power to do] for him a thing against Allāh. Those are the ones for whom Allāh does not intend to purify their hearts. For them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Messenger! Let not them grieve thee who vie one with another in the race to disbelief, of such as say with their mouths: "We believe," but their hearts believe not, and of the Jews: listeners for the sake of falsehood, listeners on behalf of other folk who come not unto thee, changing words from their context and saying: If this be given unto you, receive it, but if this be not given unto you, then beware! He whom Allah doometh unto sin, thou (by thine efforts) wilt avail him naught against Allah. Those are they for whom the Will of Allah is that He cleanse not their hearts. Theirs in the world will be ignominy, and in the Hereafter an awful doom;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْكُفْرِ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ  وَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟  سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ ءَاخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ  يُحَرِّفُونَ ٱلْكَلِمَ مِن بَعْدِ مَوَاضِعِهِ  يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَـٰذَا فَخُذُوهُ وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَٱحْذَرُوا۟  وَمَن يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُرِدِ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَهُمْ  لَهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا خِزْىٌ  وَلَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, devourers of [what is] unlawful. So if they come to you, [O Muḥammad], judge between them or turn away from them. And if you turn away from them - never will they harm you at all. And if you judge, judge between them with justice. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Listeners for the sake of falsehood! Greedy for illicit gain! If then they have recourse unto thee (Muhammad) judge between them or disclaim jurisdiction. If thou disclaimest jurisdiction, then they cannot harm thee at all. But if thou judgest, judge between them with equity. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَمَّـٰعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ أَكَّـٰلُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ  فَإِن جَآءُوكَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُمْ أَوْ أَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ  وَإِن تُعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ فَلَن يَضُرُّوكَ شَيْـًٔا  وَإِنْ حَكَمْتَ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْقِسْطِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But how is it that they come to you for judgement while they have the Torah, in which is the judgement of Allāh? Then they turn away, [even] after that; but those are not [in fact] believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How come they unto thee for judgment when they have the Torah, wherein Allah hath delivered judgment (for them)? Yet even after that they turn away. Such (folk) are not believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَيْفَ يُحَكِّمُونَكَ وَعِندَهُمُ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ فِيهَا حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ  وَمَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which was guidance and light. The prophets who submitted [to Allāh] judged by it for the Jews, as did the rabbis and scholars by that with which they were entrusted of the Scripture of Allāh, and they were witnesses thereto. So do not fear the people but fear Me, and do not exchange My verses for a small price [i.e., worldly gain]. And whoever does not judge by what Allāh has revealed - then it is those who are the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We did reveal the Torah, wherein is guidance and a light, by which the prophets who surrendered (unto Allah) judged the Jews, and the rabbis and the priests (judged) by such of Allah's Scripture as they were bidden to observe, and thereunto were they witnesses. So fear not mankind, but fear Me. And My revelations for a little gain. Whoso judgeth not by that which Allah hath revealed: such are disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ فِيهَا هُدًى وَنُورٌ  يَحْكُمُ بِهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْلَمُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلرَّبَّـٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ بِمَا ٱسْتُحْفِظُوا۟ مِن كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ شُهَدَآءَ  فَلَا تَخْشَوُا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱخْشَوْنِ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا  وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We ordained for them therein a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and for wounds is legal retribution. But whoever gives [up his right as] charity, it is an expiation for him. And whoever does not judge by what Allāh has revealed - then it is those who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We prescribed for them therein: The life for the life, and the eye for the eye, and the nose for the nose, and the ear for the ear, and the tooth for the tooth, and for wounds retaliation. But whoso forgoeth it (in the way of charity) it shall be expiation for him. Whoso judgeth not by that which Allah hath revealed: such are wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيهَآ أَنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ بِٱلنَّفْسِ وَٱلْعَيْنَ بِٱلْعَيْنِ وَٱلْأَنفَ بِٱلْأَنفِ وَٱلْأُذُنَ بِٱلْأُذُنِ وَٱلسِّنَّ بِٱلسِّنِّ وَٱلْجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌ  فَمَن تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَّهُ  وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We sent, following in their footsteps, Jesus, the son of Mary, confirming that which came before him in the Torah; and We gave him the Gospel, in which was guidance and light and confirming that which preceded it of the Torah as guidance and instruction for the righteous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow in their footsteps, confirming that which was (revealed) before him in the Torah, and We bestowed on him the Gospel wherein is guidance and a light, confirming that which was (revealed) before it in the Torah - a guidance and an admonition unto those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ  وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ فِيهِ هُدًى وَنُورٌ وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And let the People of the Gospel judge by what Allāh has revealed therein. And whoever does not judge by what Allāh has revealed - then it is those who are the defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Let the People of the Gospel judge by that which Allah hath revealed therein. Whoso judgeth not by that which Allah hath revealed: such are evil-livers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلْيَحْكُمْ أَهْلُ ٱلْإِنجِيلِ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِ  وَمَن لَّمْ يَحْكُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in truth, confirming that which preceded it of the Scripture and as a criterion over it. So judge between them by what Allāh has revealed and do not follow their inclinations away from what has come to you of the truth. To each of you We prescribed a law and a method. Had Allāh willed, He would have made you one nation [united in religion], but [He intended] to test you in what He has given you; so race to [all that is] good. To Allāh is your return all together, and He will [then] inform you concerning that over which you used to differ.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And unto thee have We revealed the Scripture with the truth, confirming whatever Scripture was before it, and a watcher over it. So judge between them by that which Allah hath revealed, and follow not their desires away from the truth which hath come unto thee. For each We have appointed a divine law and a traced-out way. Had Allah willed He could have made you one community. But that He may try you by that which He hath given you (He hath made you as ye are). So vie one with another in good works. Unto Allah ye will all return, and He will then inform you of that wherein ye differ.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ  فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ  وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ  لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا  وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ  فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ  إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And judge, [O Muḥammad], between them by what Allāh has revealed and do not follow their inclinations and beware of them, lest they tempt you away from some of what Allāh has revealed to you. And if they turn away - then know that Allāh only intends to afflict them with some of their [own] sins. And indeed, many among the people are defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So judge between them by that which Allah hath revealed, and follow not their desires, but beware of them lest they seduce thee from some part of that which Allah hath revealed unto thee. And if they turn away, then know that Allah's Will is to smite them for some sin of theirs. Lo! many of mankind are evil-livers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنِ ٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَٱحْذَرْهُمْ أَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَن بَعْضِ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ  فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُصِيبَهُم بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ  وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then is it the judgement of [the time of] ignorance they desire? But who is better than Allāh in judgement for a people who are certain [in faith].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is it a judgment of the time of (pagan) ignorance that they are seeking? Who is better than Allah for judgment to a people who have certainty (in their belief)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَحُكْمَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ  وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. They are [in fact] allies of one another. And whoever is an ally to them among you - then indeed, he is [one] of them. Indeed, Allāh guides not the wrongdoing people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Take not the Jews and the Christians for friends. They are friends one to another. He among you who taketh them for friends is (one) of them. Lo! Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ  بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ  وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] hastening into [association with] them, saying, "We are afraid a misfortune may strike us." But perhaps Allāh will bring conquest or a decision from Him, and they will become, over what they have been concealing within themselves, regretful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou seest those in whose heart is a disease race toward them, saying: We fear lest a change of fortune befall us. And it may happen that Allah will vouchsafe (unto thee) the victory, or a commandment from His presence. Then will they repent them of their secret thoughts.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَتَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِيهِمْ يَقُولُونَ نَخْشَىٰٓ أَن تُصِيبَنَا دَآئِرَةٌ  فَعَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِٱلْفَتْحِ أَوْ أَمْرٍ مِّنْ عِندِهِ فَيُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَسَرُّوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who believe will say, "Are these the ones who swore by Allāh their strongest oaths that indeed they were with you?" Their deeds have become worthless, and they have become losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then will the believers say (unto the people of the Scripture): are these they who swore by Allah their most binding oaths that they were surely with you? Their works have failed, and they have become the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ٱلَّذِينَ أَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ  إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ  حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, whoever of you should revert from his religion - Allāh will bring forth [in place of them] a people He will love and who will love Him [who are] humble toward the believers, strong against the disbelievers; they strive in the cause of Allāh and do not fear the blame of a critic. That is the favor of Allāh; He bestows it upon whom He wills. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Whoso of you becometh a renegade from his religion, (know that in his stead) Allah will bring a people whom He loveth and who love Him, humble toward believers, stern toward disbelievers, striving in the way of Allah, and fearing not the blame of any blamer. Such is the grace of Allah which He giveth unto whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُٓ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ يُجَـٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍ  ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Your ally is none but Allāh and [therefore] His Messenger and those who have believed - those who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they bow [in worship].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Your guardian can be only Allah; and His messenger and those who believe, who establish worship and pay the poordue, and bow down (in prayer).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُمْ رَٰكِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever is an ally of Allāh and His Messenger and those who have believed - indeed, the party of Allāh - they will be the predominant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And whoso taketh Allah and His messenger and those who believe for guardian (will know that), lo! the party of Allah, they are the victorious.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, take not those who have taken your religion in ridicule and amusement among the ones who were given the Scripture before you nor the disbelievers as allies. And fear Allāh, if you should [truly] be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Ye who believe! Choose not for guardians such of those who received the Scripture before you, and of the disbelievers, as make a jest and sport of your religion. But keep your duty to Allah if ye are true believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَكُمْ هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَٱلْكُفَّارَ أَوْلِيَآءَ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you call to prayer, they take it in ridicule and amusement. That is because they are a people who do not use reason.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when ye call to prayer they take it for a jest and sport. That is because they are a folk who understand not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا نَادَيْتُمْ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوًا وَلَعِبًا  ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O People of the Scripture, do you resent us except [for the fact] that we have believed in Allāh and what was revealed to us and what was revealed before and because most of you are defiantly disobedient?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: O People of the Scripture! Do ye blame us for aught else than that we believe in Allah and that which is revealed unto us and that which was revealed aforetime, and because most of you are evil-livers?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هَلْ تَنقِمُونَ مِنَّآ إِلَّآ أَنْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that as penalty from Allāh? [It is that of] those whom Allāh has cursed and with whom He became angry and made of them apes and pigs and slaves of ṭāghūt. Those are worse in position and further astray from the sound way."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Shall I tell thee of a worse (case) than theirs for retribution with Allah? (Worse is the case of him) whom Allah hath cursed, him on whom His wrath hath fallen and of whose sort Allah hath turned some to apes and swine, and who serveth idols. Such are in worse plight and further astray from the plain road.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ مَثُوبَةً عِندَ ٱللَّهِ  مَن لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَغَضِبَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْقِرَدَةَ وَٱلْخَنَازِيرَ وَعَبَدَ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they come to you, they say, "We believe." But they have entered with disbelief [in their hearts], and they have certainly left with it. And Allāh is most knowing of what they were concealing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When they come unto you (Muslims), they say: We believe; but they came in unbelief and they went out in the same; and Allah knoweth best what they were hiding.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا جَآءُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَقَد دَّخَلُوا۟ بِٱلْكُفْرِ وَهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا۟ بِهِ  وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْتُمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you see many of them hastening into sin and aggression and the devouring of [what is] unlawful. How wretched is what they have been doing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou seest many of them vying one with another in sin and transgression and their devouring of illicit gain. Verily evil is what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ  لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Why do not the rabbis and the priests forbid their evil-speaking and their devouring of illicit gain? Verily evil is their handiwork.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَوْلَا يَنْهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّـٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلْأَحْبَارُ عَن قَوْلِهِمُ ٱلْإِثْمَ وَأَكْلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحْتَ  لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَصْنَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the Jews say, "The hand of Allāh is chained." Chained are their hands, and cursed are they for what they say. Rather, both His hands are extended; He spends however He wills. And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. And We have cast among them animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. Every time they kindled the fire of war [against you], Allāh extinguished it. And they strive throughout the land [causing] corruption, and Allāh does not like corrupters.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Jews say: Allah's hand is fettered. Their hands are fettered and they are accursed for saying so. Nay, but both His hands are spread out wide in bounty. He bestoweth as He will. That which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord is certain to increase the contumacy and disbelief of many of them, and We have cast among them enmity and hatred till the Day of Resurrection. As often as they light a fire for war, Allah extinguisheth it. Their effort is for corruption in the land, and Allah loveth not corrupters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ  غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا۟ بِمَا قَالُوا۟  بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ  وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَـٰنًا وَكُفْرًا  وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةَ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ  كُلَّمَآ أَوْقَدُوا۟ نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا ٱللَّهُ  وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا  وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if only the People of the Scripture had believed and feared Allāh, We would have removed from them their misdeeds and admitted them to Gardens of Pleasure.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If only the People of the Scripture would believe and ward off (evil), surely We should remit their sins from them and surely We should bring them into Gardens of Delight.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّقَوْا۟ لَكَفَّرْنَا عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if only they had upheld [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to them from their Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān], they would have consumed [provision] from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them are a moderate [i.e., acceptable] community, but many of them - evil is that which they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If they had observed the Torah and the Gospel and that which was revealed unto them from their Lord, they would surely have been nourished from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them there are people who are moderate, but many of them are of evil conduct.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِم مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ لَأَكَلُوا۟ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِم  مِّنْهُمْ أُمَّةٌ مُّقْتَصِدَةٌ  وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ سَآءَ مَا يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Messenger, announce that which has been revealed to you from your Lord, and if you do not, then you have not conveyed His message. And Allāh will protect you from the people. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the disbelieving people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Messenger! Make known that which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord, for if thou do it not, thou wilt not have conveyed His message. Allah will protect thee from mankind. Lo! Allah guideth not the disbelieving folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ  وَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَتَهُ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْصِمُكَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O People of the Scripture, you are [standing] on nothing until you uphold [the law of] the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān]." And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. So do not grieve over the disbelieving people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say O People of the Scripture! Ye have naught (of guidance) till ye observe the Torah and the Gospel and that which was revealed unto you from your Lord. That which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) from thy Lord is certain to increase the contumacy and disbelief of many of them. But grieve not for the disbelieving folk.

{\Large
