\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَسْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ تُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ  وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَـٰنًا وَكُفْرًا  فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who have believed [in Prophet Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] and those [before him ((\ar{ﷺ}))] who were Jews or Sabeans or Christians - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who believe, and those who are Jews, and Sabaeans, and Christians - Whosoever believeth in Allah and the Last Day and doeth right - there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ وَٱلصَّـٰبِـُٔونَ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ مَنْ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We had already taken the covenant of the Children of Israel and had sent to them messengers. Whenever there came to them a messenger with what their souls did not desire, a party [of messengers] they denied, and another party they killed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We made a covenant of old with the Children of Israel and We sent unto them messengers. As often as a messenger came unto them with that which their souls desired not (they became rebellious). Some (of them) they denied and some they slew.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مِيثَـٰقَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا  كُلَّمَا جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَرِيقًا كَذَّبُوا۟ وَفَرِيقًا يَقْتُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they thought there would be no [resulting] punishment, so they became blind and deaf. Then Allāh turned to them in forgiveness; then [again] many of them became blind and deaf. And Allāh is Seeing of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They thought no harm would come of it, so they were wilfully blind and deaf. And afterward Allah turned (in mercy) toward them. Now (even after that) are many of them wilfully blind and deaf. Allah is Seer of what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَحَسِبُوٓا۟ أَلَّا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ فَعَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ ثُمَّ تَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ عَمُوا۟ وَصَمُّوا۟ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allāh is the Messiah, the son of Mary" while the Messiah has said, "O Children of Israel, worship Allāh, my Lord and your Lord." Indeed, he who associates others with Allāh - Allāh has forbidden him Paradise, and his refuge is the Fire. And there are not for the wrongdoers any helpers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They surely disbelieve who say: Lo! Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary. The Messiah (himself) said: O Children of Israel, worship Allah, my Lord and your Lord. Lo! whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, for him Allah hath forbidden paradise. His abode is the Fire. For evil-doers there will be no helpers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ  وَقَالَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ  إِنَّهُ مَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ ٱلنَّارُ  وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allāh is the third of three." And there is no god except one God. And if they do not desist from what they are saying, there will surely afflict the disbelievers among them a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They surely disbelieve who say: Lo! Allah is the third of three; when there is no Allah save the One Allah. If they desist not from so saying a painful doom will fall on those of them who disbelieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ  وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ  وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So will they not repent to Allāh and seek His forgiveness? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Will they not rather turn unto Allah and seek forgiveness of Him? For Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Messiah, son of Mary, was not but a messenger; [other] messengers have passed on before him. And his mother was a supporter of truth. They both used to eat food. Look how We make clear to them the signs; then look how they are deluded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Messiah, son of Mary, was no other than a messenger, messengers (the like of whom) had passed away before him. And his mother was a saintly woman. And they both used to eat (earthly) food. See how We make the revelations clear for them, and see how they are turned away!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَّا ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ  كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ ٱلطَّعَامَ  ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُبَيِّنُ لَهُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ثُمَّ ٱنظُرْ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Do you worship besides Allāh that which holds for you no [power of] harm or benefit while it is Allāh who is the Hearing, the Knowing?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Serve ye in place of Allah that which possesseth for you neither hurt nor use? Allah it is Who is the Hearer, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا  وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O People of the Scripture, do not exceed limits in your religion beyond the truth and do not follow the inclinations of a people who had gone astray before and misled many and have strayed from the soundness of the way."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: O People of the Scripture! Stress not in your religion other than the truth, and follow not the vain desires of folk who erred of old and led many astray, and erred from a plain road.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَ قَوْمٍ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ وَأَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا وَضَلُّوا۟ عَن سَوَآءِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Cursed were those who disbelieved among the Children of Israel by the tongue of David and of Jesus, the son of Mary. That was because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those of the Children of Israel who went astray were cursed by the tongue of David, and of Jesus, son of Mary. That was because they rebelled and used to transgress.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لُعِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ لِسَانِ دَاوُدَ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ  ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing that they did. How wretched was that which they were doing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They restrained not one another from the wickedness they did. Verily evil was that they used to do!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَانُوا۟ لَا يَتَنَاهَوْنَ عَن مُّنكَرٍ فَعَلُوهُ  لَبِئْسَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You see many of them becoming allies of those who disbelieved [i.e., the polytheists]. How wretched is that which they have put forth for themselves in that Allāh has become angry with them, and in the punishment they will abide eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou seest many of them making friends with those who disbelieve. Surely ill for them is that which they themselves send on before them: that Allah will be wroth with them and in the doom they will abide.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تَرَىٰ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟  لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ أَن سَخِطَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَفِى ٱلْعَذَابِ هُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they had believed in Allāh and the Prophet and in what was revealed to him, they would not have taken them as allies; but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If they believed in Allah and the Prophet and that which is revealed unto him, they would not choose them for their friends. But many of them are of evil conduct.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلنَّبِىِّ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا ٱتَّخَذُوهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You will surely find the most intense of the people in animosity toward the believers [to be] the Jews and those who associate others with Allāh; and you will find the nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say, "We are Christians." That is because among them are priests and monks and because they are not arrogant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou wilt find the most vehement of mankind in hostility to those who believe (to be) the Jews and the idolaters. And thou wilt find the nearest of them in affection to those who believe (to be) those who say: Lo! We are Christians. That is because there are among them priests and monks, and because they are not proud.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ ٱلنَّاسِ عَدَٰوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلْيَهُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟  وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا نَصَـٰرَىٰ  ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they hear what has been revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth. They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When they listen to that which hath been revealed unto the messengers, thou seest their eyes overflow with tears because of their recognition of the Truth. They say: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا۟ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ تَرَىٰٓ أَعْيُنَهُمْ تَفِيضُ مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعِ مِمَّا عَرَفُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ  يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{5:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And why should we not believe in Allāh and what has come to us of the truth? And we aspire that our Lord will admit us [to Paradise] with the righteous people."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How should we not believe in Allah and that which hath come unto us of the Truth. And (how should we not) hope that our Lord will bring us in along with righteous folk?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا لَنَا لَا نُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَنَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 16, An-Naĥl (The Bee)
Verses 98 -- 105}

The 70th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{16:98}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:99}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! he hath no power over those who believe and put trust in their Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:100}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: His power is only over those who make a friend of him, and those who ascribe partners unto Him (Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا سُلْطَـٰنُهُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:101}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allāh is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muḥammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We put a revelation in place of (another) revelation, - and Allah knoweth best what He revealeth - they say: Lo! thou art but inventing. Most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ ءَايَةً مَّكَانَ ءَايَةٍ  وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍۭ  بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:102}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "The Pure Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: The holy Spirit hath delivered it from thy Lord with truth, that it may confirm (the faith of) those who believe, and as guidance and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ ٱلْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:103}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches him [i.e., the Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))]." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this [recitation, i.e., Qur’ān] is [in] a clear Arabic language.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We know well that they say: Only a man teacheth him. The speech of him at whom they falsely hint is outlandish, and this is clear Arabic speech.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ  لِّسَانُ ٱلَّذِى يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِىٌّ وَهَـٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِىٌّ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:104}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allāh - Allāh will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, Allah guideth them not and theirs will be a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{16:105}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allāh, and it is those who are the liars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Only they invent falsehood who believe not Allah's revelations, and (only) they are the liars.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى ٱلْكَذِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ  وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 6, Al-'An`ām (The Cattle)
Verses 4 -- 10}

The 55th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{6:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For they had denied the truth when it came to them, but there is going to reach them the news of what they used to ridicule.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ  فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them which We had established upon the earth as We have not established you? And We sent [rain from] the sky upon them in showers and made rivers flow beneath them; then We destroyed them for their sins and brought forth after them a generation of others.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّكُمْ وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْهِم مِّدْرَارًا وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرَ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And even if We had sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], a written scripture on a page and they touched it with their hands, the disbelievers would say, "This is not but obvious magic."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ كِتَـٰبًا فِى قِرْطَاسٍ فَلَمَسُوهُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ لَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "Why was there not sent down to him an angel?" But if We had sent down an angel, the matter would have been decided; then they would not be reprieved.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They say: Why hath not an angel been sent down unto him? If We sent down an angel, then the matter would be judged; no further time would be allowed them (for reflection).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ  وَلَوْ أَنزَلْنَا مَلَكًا لَّقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنظَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We had made him [i.e., the messenger] an angel, We would have made him [appear as] a man, and We would have covered them with that in which they cover themselves [i.e., confusion and doubt].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَلَكًا لَّجَعَلْنَـٰهُ رَجُلًا وَلَلَبَسْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّا يَلْبِسُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{6:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by that which they used to ridicule.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 17, Al-'Isrā (The Night Journey)
Verses 58 -- 72}

The 50th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{17:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is not a township but We shall destroy it ere the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with dire punishment. That is set forth in the Book (of Our decrees).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا  كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent save to warn.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ  وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا  وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (it was a warning) when we told thee: Lo! thy Lord encompasseth mankind, and We appointed the sight which We showed thee as an ordeal for mankind, and (likewise) the Accursed Tree in the Qur'an. We warn them, but it increaseth them in naught save gross impiety.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ  وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ  وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَـٰنًا كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We said unto the angels: Fall down prostrate before Adam and they fell prostrate all save Iblis, he said: Shall I fall prostrate before that which Thou hast created of clay?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Seest Thou this (creature) whom Thou hast honoured above me, if Thou give me grace until the Day of Resurrection I verily will seize his seed, save but a few.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Allāh] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: Go, and whosoever of them followeth thee - lo! hell will be your payment, ample payment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءً مَّوْفُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And incite [to senselessness] whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them." But Satan does not promise them except delusion.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And excite any of them whom thou canst with thy voice, and urge thy horse and foot against them, and be a partner in their wealth and children, and promise them. Satan promiseth them only to deceive.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ  وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, over My [believing] servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! My (faithful) bondmen - over them thou hast no power, and thy Lord sufficeth as (their) guardian.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ  وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (O mankind), your Lord is He Who driveth for you the ship upon the sea that ye may seek of His bounty. Lo! He was ever Merciful toward you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِٓ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is man ungrateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ  فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ  وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ كَفُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ  ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ تَبِيعًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Verily we have honoured the Children of Adam. We carry them on the land and the sea, and have made provision of good things for them, and have preferred them above many of those whom We created with a marked preferment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Mention, O Muḥammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when We shall summon all men with their record, whoso is given his book in his right hand - such will read their book and they will not be wronged a shred.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ نَدْعُوا۟ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۭ بِإِمَـٰمِهِمْ  فَمَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَـٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray in way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whoso is blind here will be blind in the Hereafter, and yet further from the road.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَـٰذِهِٓ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 17, Al-'Isrā (The Night Journey)
Verse 1}

The 50th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{17:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Exalted is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] by night from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām to al-Masjid al-Aqṣā, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Glorified be He Who carried His servant by night from the Inviolable Place of Worship to the Far distant place of worship the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, that We might show him of Our tokens! Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَـٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِيَهُ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَآ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 15, Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract)
Verses 85 -- 99}

The 54th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{15:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ  وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ  فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:89}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:90}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Such as We send down for those who make division,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:91}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:92}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:93}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: About what they used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Of what they used to do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:94}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:95}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:96}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ  فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:97}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:98}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{15:99}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 275 -- 281}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:275}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who consume interest cannot stand [on the Day of Resurrection] except as one stands who is being beaten by Satan into insanity. That is because they say, "Trade is [just] like interest." But Allāh has permitted trade and has forbidden interest. So whoever has received an admonition from his Lord and desists may have what is past, and his affair rests with Allāh. But whoever returns [to dealing in interest or usury] - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide eternally therein.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who swallow usury cannot rise up save as he ariseth whom the devil hath prostrated by (his) touch. That is because they say: Trade is just like usury; whereas Allah permitteth trading and forbiddeth usury. He unto whom an admonition from his Lord cometh, and (he) refraineth (in obedience thereto), he shall keep (the profits of) that which is past, and his affair (henceforth) is with Allah. As for him who returneth (to usury) - Such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مِنَ ٱلْمَسِّ  ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟  وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟  فَمَن جَآءَهُ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمْرُهُٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ  وَمَنْ عَادَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:276}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh destroys interest and gives increase for charities. And Allāh does not like every sinning disbeliever.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath blighted usury and made almsgiving fruitful. Allah loveth not the impious and guilty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَمْحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَيُرْبِى ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ  وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:277}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakāh will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who believe and do good works and establish worship and pay the poor-due, their reward is with their Lord and there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:278}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَذَرُوا۟ مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:279}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you do not, then be informed of a war [against you] from Allāh and His Messenger. But if you repent, you may have your principal - [thus] you do no wrong, nor are you wronged.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if ye do not, then be warned of war (against you) from Allah and His messenger. And if ye repent, then ye have your principal (without interest). Wrong not, and ye shall not be wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَأْذَنُوا۟ بِحَرْبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ  وَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَلَكُمْ رُءُوسُ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ لَا تَظْلِمُونَ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:280}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you give [from your right as] charity, then it is better for you, if you only knew.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if the debtor is in straitened circumstances, then (let there be) postponement to (the time of) ease; and that ye remit the debt as almsgiving would be better for you if ye did but know.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيْسَرَةٍ  وَأَن تَصَدَّقُوا۟ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:281}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And fear a Day when you will be returned to Allāh. Then every soul will be compensated for what it earned, and they will not be wronged [i.e., treated unjustly].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And guard yourselves against a day in which ye will be brought back to Allah. Then every soul will be paid in full that which it hath earned, and they will not be wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا تُرْجَعُونَ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ  ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 38, Şād (The Letter "Saad")
Verses 1 -- 11}

The 38th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{38:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 صٓ  وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ  وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا  إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ  إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا  بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى  بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا  فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{38:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 46, Al-'Aĥqāf (The Wind-Curved Sandhills)
Verses 28 -- 30}

The 66th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{46:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قُرْبَانًا ءَالِهَةً  بَلْ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنْهُمْ  وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{46:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَآ إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنصِتُوا۟  فَلَمَّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوْا۟ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{46:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰقَوْمَنَآ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَـٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 7}
\section{Surah 60, Al-Mumtaĥanah (She that is to be examined)
All Verses (1 -- 13)}

The 91st revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{60:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ عَدُوِّى وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ  أَن تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَـٰدًا فِى سَبِيلِى وَٱبْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِى  تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَآ أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَآ أَعْلَنتُمْ  وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If they have the upper hand of you, they will be your foes, and will stretch out their hands and their tongues toward you with evil (intent), and they long for you to disbelieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا۟ لَكُمْ أَعْدَآءً وَيَبْسُطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ  يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُٓ إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُا۟ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلْبَغْضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ  رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآ  إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ  وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً  وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا يَنْهَىٰكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَـٰرِكُمْ وَظَـٰهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ  وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. Allāh is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allāh; He judges between you. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! When believing women come unto you as fugitives, examine them. Allah is Best Aware of their faith. Then, if ye know them for true believers, send them not back unto the disbelievers. They are not lawful for them (the disbelievers), nor are they (the disbelievers) lawful for them. And give them (the disbelievers) that which they have spent (upon them). And it is no sin for you to marry such women when ye have given them their dues. And hold not to the ties of disbelieving women; and ask for (the return of) that which ye have spent; and let them (the disbelievers) ask for that which they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah. He judgeth between you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ مُهَـٰجِرَٰتٍ فَٱمْتَحِنُوهُنَّ  ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَـٰنِهِنَّ  فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَـٰتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ  لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ  وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُوا۟  وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ  وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا۟ بِعِصَمِ ٱلْكَوَافِرِ وَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔلُوا۟ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟  ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ ٱللَّهِ  يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if any of your wives have gone from you unto the disbelievers and afterward ye have your turn (of triumph), then give unto those whose wives have gone the like of that which they have spent, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَىْءٌ مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَـَٔاتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَٰجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنفَقُوا۟  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allāh, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! If believing women come unto thee, taking oath of allegiance unto thee that they will ascribe no thing as partner unto Allah, and will neither steal nor commit adultery nor kill their children, nor produce any lie that they have devised between their hands and feet, nor disobey thee in what is right, then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَـٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَـٰنٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِى مَعْرُوفٍ  فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{60:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are in the graves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْقُبُورِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 22, Al-Ĥajj (The Pilgrimage)
Verses 38 -- 51}

The 103rd revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{22:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah defendeth those who are true. Lo! Allah loveth not each treacherous ingrate.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allāh is competent to give them victory.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Sanction is given unto those who fight because they have been wronged; and Allah is indeed Able to give them victory;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا۟  وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allāh." And were it not that Allāh checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allāh is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And Allāh will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّآ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ  وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضٍ لَّهُدِّمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَٰتٌ وَمَسَـٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا ٱسْمُ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا  وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُٓ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allāh belongs the outcome of [all] matters.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish worship and pay the poor-due and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity. And Allah's is the sequel of events.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُوا۟ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا۟ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ  وَلِلَّهِ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers);

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the folk of Abraham and the folk of Lot;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَصْحَـٰبُ مَدْيَنَ  وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ  فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوْ ءَاذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا  فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَلَـٰكِن تَعْمَى ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allāh will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِٱلْعَذَابِ وَلَن يُخْلِفَ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ  وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{22:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 190 -- 195}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:190}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Fight in the way of Allāh those who fight against you but do not transgress. Indeed, Allāh does not like transgressors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Fight in the way of Allah against those who fight against you, but begin not hostilities. Lo! Allah loveth not aggressors.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ وَلَا تَعْتَدُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:191}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And kill them [in battle] wherever you overtake them and expel them from wherever they have expelled you, and fitnah is worse than killing. And do not fight them at al-Masjid al-Ḥarām until they fight you there. But if they fight you, then kill them. Such is the recompense of the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And slay them wherever ye find them, and drive them out of the places whence they drove you out, for persecution is worse than slaughter. And fight not with them at the Inviolable Place of Worship until they first attack you there, but if they attack you (there) then slay them. Such is the reward of disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ حَيْثُ ثَقِفْتُمُوهُمْ وَأَخْرِجُوهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ أَخْرَجُوكُمْ  وَٱلْفِتْنَةُ أَشَدُّ مِنَ ٱلْقَتْلِ  وَلَا تُقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ حَتَّىٰ يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ فِيهِ  فَإِن قَـٰتَلُوكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوهُمْ  كَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:192}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they cease, then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But if they desist, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:193}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Fight them until there is no [more] fitnah and [until] religion [i.e., worship] is [acknowledged to be] for Allāh. But if they cease, then there is to be no aggression [i.e., assault] except against the oppressors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And fight them until persecution is no more, and religion is for Allah. But if they desist, then let there be no hostility except against wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ لِلَّهِ  فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَلَا عُدْوَٰنَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:194}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Battle in] the sacred month is for [aggression committed in] the sacred month, and for [all] violations is legal retribution. So whoever has assaulted you, then assault him in the same way that he has assaulted you. And fear Allāh and know that Allāh is with those who fear Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The forbidden month for the forbidden month, and forbidden things in retaliation. And one who attacketh you, attack him in like manner as he attacked you. Observe your duty to Allah, and know that Allah is with those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلشَّهْرُ ٱلْحَرَامُ بِٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْحُرُمَـٰتُ قِصَاصٌ  فَمَنِ ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱعْتَدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا ٱعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:195}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And spend in the way of Allāh and do not throw [yourselves] with your [own] hands into destruction [by refraining]. And do good; indeed, Allāh loves the doers of good.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Spend your wealth for the cause of Allah, and be not cast by your own hands to ruin; and do good. Lo! Allah loveth the beneficent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تُلْقُوا۟ بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى ٱلتَّهْلُكَةِ  وَأَحْسِنُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 216 -- 218}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:216}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Battle has been enjoined upon you while it is hateful to you. But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you; and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you. And Allāh knows, while you know not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Warfare is ordained for you, though it is hateful unto you; but it may happen that ye hate a thing which is good for you, and it may happen that ye love a thing which is bad for you. Allah knoweth, ye know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ  وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:217}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They ask you about the sacred month - about fighting therein. Say, "Fighting therein is great [sin], but averting [people] from the way of Allāh and disbelief in Him and [preventing access to] al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and the expulsion of its people therefrom are greater [evil] in the sight of Allāh. And fitnah is greater than killing." And they will continue to fight you until they turn you back from your religion if they are able. And whoever of you reverts from his religion [to disbelief] and dies while he is a disbeliever - for those, their deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They question thee (O Muhammad) with regard to warfare in the sacred month. Say: Warfare therein is a great (transgression), but to turn (men) from the way of Allah, and to disbelieve in Him and in the Inviolable Place of Worship, and to expel His people thence, is a greater with Allah; for persecution is worse than killing. And they will not cease from fighting against you till they have made you renegades from your religion, if they can. And whoso becometh a renegade and dieth in his disbelief: such are they whose works have fallen both in the world and the Hereafter. Such are rightful owners of the Fire: they will abide therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلشَّهْرِ ٱلْحَرَامِ قِتَالٍ فِيهِ  قُلْ قِتَالٌ فِيهِ كَبِيرٌ  وَصَدٌّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَكُفْرٌ بِهِ وَٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَإِخْرَاجُ أَهْلِهِ مِنْهُ أَكْبَرُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱلْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ ٱلْقَتْلِ  وَلَا يَزَالُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَن دِينِكُمْ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟  وَمَن يَرْتَدِدْ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِ فَيَمُتْ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ  وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:218}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who have believed and those who have emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh - those expect the mercy of Allāh. And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who believe, and those who emigrate (to escape the persecution) and strive in the way of Allah, these have hope of Allah's mercy. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 8, Al-'Anfāl (The Spoils of War)
All Verses (1 -- 75)}

The 88th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{8:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allāh and the Messenger." So fear Allāh and amend that which is between you and obey Allāh and His Messenger, if you should be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They ask thee (O Muhammad) of the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the messenger, so keep your duty to Allah, and adjust the matter of your difference, and obey Allah and His messenger, if ye are (true) believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَنفَالِ  قُلِ ٱلْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ  فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا۟ ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ  وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The believers are only those who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited unto them they increase their faith, and who trust in their Lord;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُهُ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who establish worship and spend of that We have bestowed on them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those are they who are in truth believers. For them are grades (of honour) with their Lord, and pardon, and a bountiful provision.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا  لَّهُمْ دَرَجَـٰتٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Even as thy Lord caused thee (Muhammad) to go forth from thy home with the Truth, and lo! a party of the believers were averse (to it).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَـٰرِهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Disputing with thee of the Truth after it had been made manifest, as if they were being driven to death visible.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُجَـٰدِلُونَكَ فِى ٱلْحَقِّ بَعْدَ مَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember, O believers], when Allāh promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allāh intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers
