\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Allah promised you one of the two bands (of the enemy) that it should be yours, and ye longed that other than the armed one might be yours. And Allah willed that He should cause the Truth to triumph by His words, and cut the root of the disbelievers;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّآئِفَتَيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ وَتَوَدُّونَ أَنَّ غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ تَكُونُ لَكُمْ وَيُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ أَن يُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَـٰتِهِ وَيَقْطَعَ دَابِرَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِيُحِقَّ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيُبْطِلَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When ye sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels, rank on rank.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّى مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah appointed it only as good tidings, and that your hearts thereby might be at rest. Victory cometh only by the help of Allah. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ  وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِّنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمْ رِجْزَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلْأَقْدَامَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ يُوحِى رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّى مَعَكُمْ فَثَبِّتُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟  سَأُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَٱضْرِبُوا۟ فَوْقَ ٱلْأَعْنَاقِ وَٱضْرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That is because they opposed Allah and His messenger. Whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, (for him) lo! Allah is severe in punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ  وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That (is the award), so taste it, and (know) that for disbelievers is the torment of the Fire.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! When ye meet those who disbelieve in battle, turn not your backs to them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ زَحْفًا فَلَا تُوَلُّوهُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allāh, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whoso on that day turneth his back to them, unless manoeuvring for battle or intent to join a company, he truly hath incurred wrath from Allah, and his habitation will be hell, a hapless journey's end.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُٓ إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفًا لِّقِتَالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزًا إِلَىٰ فِئَةٍ فَقَدْ بَآءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ  وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you did not kill them, but it was Allāh who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ye (Muslims) slew them not, but Allah slew them. And thou (Muhammad) threwest not when thou didst throw, but Allah threw, that He might test the believers by a fair test from Him. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ  وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ  وَلِيُبْلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلَآءً حَسَنًا  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That [is so], and [also] that Allāh will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That (is the case); and (know) that Allah (it is) Who maketh weak the plan of disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (O Qureysh!) If ye sought a judgment, now hath the judgment come unto you. And if ye cease (from persecuting the believers) it will be better for you, but if ye return (to the attack) We also shall return. And your host will avail you naught, however numerous it be, and (know) that Allah is with the believers (in His Guidance).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِن تَسْتَفْتِحُوا۟ فَقَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلْفَتْحُ  وَإِن تَنتَهُوا۟ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  وَإِن تَعُودُوا۟ نَعُدْ وَلَن تُغْنِىَ عَنكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and His messenger, and turn not away from him when ye hear (him speak).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Be not as those who say, we hear, and they hear not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf, the dumb, who have no sense.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلْبُكْمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had Allah known of any good in them He would have made them hear, but had He made them hear they would have turned away, averse.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ عَلِمَ ٱللَّهُ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا لَّأَسْمَعَهُمْ  وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ لَتَوَلَّوا۟ وَّهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Obey Allah, and the messenger when He calleth you to that which quickeneth you, and know that Allah cometh in between the man and his own heart, and that He it is unto Whom ye will be gathered.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ  وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And guard yourselves against a chastisement which cannot fall exclusively on those of you who are wrong-doers, and know that Allah is severe in punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ فِتْنَةً لَّا تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً  وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And remember, when ye were few and reckoned feeble in the land, and were in fear lest men should extirpate you, how He gave you refuge, and strengthened you with His help, and made provision of good things for you, that haply ye might be thankful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ أَنتُمْ قَلِيلٌ مُّسْتَضْعَفُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَـَٔاوَىٰكُمْ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصْرِهِ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not betray Allāh and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Betray not Allah and His messenger, nor knowingly betray your trusts.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَخُونُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوٓا۟ أَمَـٰنَـٰتِكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allāh has with Him a great reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And know that your possessions and your children are a test, and that with Allah is immense reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, if you fear Allāh, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! If ye keep your duty to Allah, He will give you discrimination (between right and wrong) and will rid you of your evil thoughts and deeds, and will forgive you. Allah is of Infinite Bounty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allāh plans. And Allāh is the best of planners.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when those who disbelieve plot against thee (O Muhammad) to wound thee fatally, or to kill thee or to drive thee forth; they plot, but Allah (also) plotteth; and Allah is the best of plotters.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ يَمْكُرُ بِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيُثْبِتُوكَ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ  وَيَمْكُرُونَ وَيَمْكُرُ ٱللَّهُ  وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Our revelations are recited unto them they say: We have heard. If we wish we can speak the like of this. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالُوا۟ قَدْ سَمِعْنَا لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَقُلْنَا مِثْلَ هَـٰذَآ  إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember] when they said, "O Allāh, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when they said: O Allah! If this be indeed the truth from Thee, then rain down stones on us or bring on us some painful doom!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالُوا۟ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَـٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَوِ ٱئْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But Allah would not punish them while thou wast with them, nor will He punish them while they seek forgiveness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَأَنتَ فِيهِمْ  وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But why should Allāh not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: What (plea) have they that Allah should not punish them, when they debar (His servants) from the Inviolable Place of Worship, though they are not its fitting guardians. Its fitting guardians are those only who keep their duty to Allah. But most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلَّا يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ أَوْلِيَآءَهُٓ  إِنْ أَوْلِيَآؤُهُٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And their prayer at the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved [i.e., practiced of deviations].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And their worship at the (holy) House is naught but whistling and hand-clapping. Therefore (it is said unto them): Taste of the doom because ye disbelieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كَانَ صَلَاتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلَّا مُكَآءً وَتَصْدِيَةً  فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allāh. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who disbelieve spend their wealth in order that they may debar (men) from the way of Allah. They will spend it, then it will become an anguish for them, then they will be conquered. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto hell,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ لِيَصُدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ  فَسَيُنفِقُونَهَا ثُمَّ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسْرَةً ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ  وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ يُحْشَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It is] so that Allāh may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That Allah may separate the wicked from the good, The wicked will He place piece upon piece, and heap them all together, and consign them unto hell. Such verily are the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِيَمِيزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَيَجْعَلَ ٱلْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِى جَهَنَّمَ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Tell those who disbelieve that if they cease (from persecution of believers) that which is past will be forgiven them; but if they return (thereto) then the example of the men of old hath already gone (before them, for a warning).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَنتَهُوا۟ يُغْفَرْ لَهُم مَّا قَدْ سَلَفَ وَإِن يَعُودُوا۟ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And fight against them until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion [i.e., worship], all of it, is for Allāh. And if they cease - then indeed, Allāh is Seeing of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And fight them until persecution is no more, and religion is all for Allah. But if they cease, then lo! Allah is Seer of what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَـٰتِلُوهُمْ حَتَّىٰ لَا تَكُونَ فِتْنَةٌ وَيَكُونَ ٱلدِّينُ كُلُّهُ لِلَّهِ  فَإِنِ ٱنتَهَوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your Befriender - a Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ  نِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And know that whatever ye take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, if ye believe in Allah and that which We revealed unto Our slave on the Day of Discrimination, the day when the two armies met. And Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَـٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينِ وَٱبْنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمْ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When ye were on the near bank (of the valley) and they were on the yonder bank, and the caravan was below you (on the coast plain). And had ye trysted to meet one another ye surely would have failed to keep the tryst, but (it happened, as it did, without the forethought of either of you) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done; that he who perished (on that day) might perish by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty) and he who survived might survive by a clear proof (of His Sovereignty). Lo! Allah in truth is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ أَنتُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُم بِٱلْعُدْوَةِ ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ  وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لَٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْمِيعَـٰدِ  وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا لِّيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَن بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَىَّ عَن بَيِّنَةٍ  وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When Allah showed them unto thee (O Muhammad) in thy dream as few in number, and if He had shown them to thee as many, ye (Muslims) would have faltered and would have quarrelled over the affair. But Allah saved (you). Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا  وَلَوْ أَرَىٰكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَـٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَلَّمَ  إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allāh are [all] matters returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when He made you (Muslims), when ye met (them), see them with your eyes as few, and lessened you in their eyes, (it was) that Allah might conclude a thing that must be done. Unto Allah all things are brought back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ ٱلْتَقَيْتُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِىٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ لِيَقْضِىَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا  وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! When ye meet an army, hold firm and think of Allah much, that ye may be successful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَٱثْبُتُوا۟ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And obey Allāh and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And obey Allah and His messenger, and dispute not one with another lest ye falter and your strength depart from you; but be steadfast! Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَا تَنَـٰزَعُوا۟ فَتَفْشَلُوا۟ وَتَذْهَبَ رِيحُكُمْ  وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Be not as those who came forth from their dwellings boastfully and to be seen of men, and debar (men) from the way of Allah, while Allah is surrounding all they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِم بَطَرًا وَرِئَآءَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Satan made their deeds seem fair to them and said: No-one of mankind can conquer you this day, for I am your protector. But when the armies came in sight of one another, he took flight, saying: Lo! I am guiltless of you. Lo! I see that which ye see not. Lo! I fear Allah. And Allah is severe in punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ وَقَالَ لَا غَالِبَ لَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَإِنِّى جَارٌ لَّكُمْ  فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَتِ ٱلْفِئَتَانِ نَكَصَ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ مَا لَا تَرَوْنَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ  وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease [i.e., arrogance and disbelief] said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is a disease said: Their religion hath deluded these. Whoso putteth his trust in Allah (will find that) lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ غَرَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ دِينُهُمْ  وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved... They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If thou couldst see how the angels receive those who disbelieve, smiting faces and their backs and (saying): Taste the punishment of burning!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟  ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is for that which your own hands have sent before (to the Judgment), and (know) that Allah is not a tyrant to His slaves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allāh, so Allāh seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and severe in penalty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they disbelieved the revelations of Allah, and Allah took them in their sins. Lo! Allah is Strong, severe in punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ  وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ  كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That is because Allah never changeth the grace He hath bestowed on any people until they first change that which is in their hearts, and (that is) because Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا نِّعْمَةً أَنْعَمَهَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ  وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Their way is) as the way of Pharaoh's folk and those before them; they denied the revelations of their Lord, so We destroyed them in their sins. And We drowned the folk of Pharaoh. All were evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ  وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ  كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ  وَكُلٌّ كَانُوا۟ ظَـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the ungrateful who will not believe.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those of them with whom thou madest a treaty, and then at every opportunity they break their treaty, and they keep not duty (to Allah).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ عَـٰهَدتَّ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَهُمْ فِى كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَتَّقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If thou comest on them in the war, deal with them so as to strike fear in those who are behind them, that haply they may remember.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِم مَّنْ خَلْفَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allāh does not like traitors.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if thou fearest treachery from any folk, then throw back to them (their treaty) fairly. Lo! Allah loveth not the treacherous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَٱنبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْخَآئِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And let not those who disbelieve suppose that they can outstrip (Allah's Purpose). Lo! they cannot escape.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَبَقُوٓا۟  إِنَّهُمْ لَا يُعْجِزُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Make ready for them all thou canst of (armed) force and of horses tethered, that thereby ye may dismay the enemy of Allah and your enemy, and others beside them whom ye know not. Allah knoweth them. Whatsoever ye spend in the way of Allah it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَعِدُّوا۟ لَهُم مَّا ٱسْتَطَعْتُم مِّن قُوَّةٍ وَمِن رِّبَاطِ ٱلْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ ٱللَّهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ وَءَاخَرِينَ مِن دُونِهِمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُهُمْ  وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they incline to peace, incline thou also to it, and trust in Allah. Lo! He, even He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَإِن جَنَحُوا۟ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن يُرِيدُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْدَعُوكَ فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ  هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَيَّدَكَ بِنَصْرِهِ وَبِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (as for the believers) hath attuned their hearts. If thou hadst spent all that is in the earth thou couldst not have attuned their hearts, but Allah hath attuned them. Lo! He is Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ  لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّآ أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ  إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Allah is Sufficient for thee and those who follow thee of the believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَسْبُكَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are steadfast], they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Exhort the believers to fight. If there be of you twenty steadfast they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a hundred (steadfast) they shall overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they (the disbelievers) are a folk without intelligence.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ حَرِّضِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ  إِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَـٰبِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ  وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Now, Allāh has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the steadfast.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Now hath Allah lightened your burden, for He knoweth that there is weakness in you. So if there be of you a steadfast hundred they shall overcome two hundred, and if there be of you a thousand (steadfast) they shall overcome two thousand by permission of Allah. Allah is with the steadfast.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ خَفَّفَ ٱللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا  فَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُم مِّا۟ئَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا۟ مِا۟ئَتَيْنِ  وَإِن يَكُن مِّنكُمْ أَلْفٌ يَغْلِبُوٓا۟ أَلْفَيْنِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world, but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not for any prophet to have captives until he hath made slaughter in the land. Ye desire the lure of this world and Allah desireth (for you) the Hereafter, and Allah is Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُٓ أَسْرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُثْخِنَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  تُرِيدُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ  وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If not for a decree from Allāh that preceded, you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had it not been for an ordinance of Allah which had gone before, an awful doom had come upon you on account of what ye took.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّوْلَا كِتَـٰبٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ سَبَقَ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِيمَآ أَخَذْتُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Now enjoy what ye have won, as lawful and good, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allāh knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Say unto those captives who are in your hands: If Allah knoweth any good in your hearts He will give you better than that which hath been taken from you, and will forgive you. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّمَن فِىٓ أَيْدِيكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَسْرَىٰٓ إِن يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ خَيْرًا يُؤْتِكُمْ خَيْرًا مِّمَّآ أُخِذَ مِنكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allāh before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they would betray thee, they betrayed Allah before, and He gave (thee) power over them. Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن يُرِيدُوا۟ خِيَانَتَكَ فَقَدْ خَانُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who believed and left their homes and strove with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them: these are protecting friends one of another. And those who believed but did not leave their homes, ye have no duty to protect them till they leave their homes; but if they seek help from you in the matter of religion then it is your duty to help (them) except against a folk between whom and you there is a treaty. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ  وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا۟ مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَـٰيَتِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا۟  وَإِنِ ٱسْتَنصَرُوكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيْكُمُ ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۭ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَـٰقٌ  وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who disbelieve are protectors one of another - If ye do not so, there will be confusion in the land, and great corruption.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ  إِلَّا تَفْعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتْنَةٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَفَسَادٌ كَبِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who believed and left their homes and strove for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them - these are the believers in truth. For them is pardon, and bountiful provision.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاوَوا۟ وَّنَصَرُوٓا۟ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا  لَّهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{8:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who afterwards believed and left their homes and strove along with you, they are of you; and those who are akin are nearer one to another in the ordinance of Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِن بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ مَعَكُمْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنكُمْ  وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 39, Az-Zumar (The Troops)
Verses 41 -- 75}

The 59th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{39:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager [i.e., authority] over them.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ  فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِ  وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا  وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَٱلَّتِى لَمْ تَمُتْ فِى مَنَامِهَا  فَيُمْسِكُ ٱلَّتِى قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they taken other than Allāh as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَ  قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "To Allāh belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ جَمِيعًا  لَّهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when Allāh is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ٱشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ  وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O Allāh, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ عَـٰلِمَ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِى مَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ  وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَـٰهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۭ  بَلْ هِىَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَدْ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟  وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do they not know that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنِيبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا۟ لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّبِعُوٓا۟ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Lest a soul should say, "Oh, [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allāh and that I was among the mockers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَـٰحَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِى جَنبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّـٰخِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allāh had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتِى فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allāh [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ  أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيُنَجِّى ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ  وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَكِيلٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and they who disbelieve the revelations of Allah - such are they who are the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّهُ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Is it other than Allāh that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأْمُرُوٓنِّىٓ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allāh, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily it hath been revealed unto thee as unto those before thee (saying): If thou ascribe a partner to Allah thy work will fail and thou indeed wilt be among the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Rather, worship [only] Allāh and be among the grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَٱلْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّـٰتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ  سُبْحَـٰنَهُ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allāh wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the trumpet is blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are in the earth swoon away, save him whom Allah willeth. Then it is blown a second time, and behold them standing waiting!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ  ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the earth shineth with the light of her Lord, and the Book is set up, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth, and they are not wronged.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَشْرَقَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَجِا۟ىٓءَ بِٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And each soul is paid in full for what it did. And He is Best Aware of what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who disbelieve are driven unto hell in troops till, when they reach it and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Came there not unto you messengers of your own, reciting unto you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? they say: Yea, verily. But the word of doom of disbelievers is fulfilled.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا  حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا  قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is said (unto them): Enter ye the gates of hell to dwell therein. Thus hapless is the journey's end of the scorners.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قِيلَ ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا  فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا  حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوهَا خَـٰلِدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath fulfilled His promise unto us and hath made us inherit the land, sojourning in the Garden where we will! So bounteous is the wage of workers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ  فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{39:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allāh] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And thou (O Muhammad) seest the angels thronging round the Throne, hymning the praises of their Lord. And they are judged aright. And it is said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَرَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ ٱلْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ  وَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 36, Yā-Sīn (Ya Sin)
All Verses (1 -- 83)}

The 41st revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{36:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Yā, Seen.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ya Sin.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يسٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: By the wise Qur’ān,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: By the wise Qur'an,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! thou art of those sent

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: On a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On a straight path,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْنَا مِن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ  فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ  وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ  لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ  أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم  بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then truly I should be in error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ  قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ  مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ  أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
