سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا  ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ  وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy..."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَن بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا   هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ  إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى  هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا  أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ  أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِى لَهُٓ  إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ  أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:74}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:75}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:76}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ  إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:77}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُ  قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ  وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم  بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{36:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 52, Aţ-Ţūr (The Mount)
Verses 29 -- 49}

The 76th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{52:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ  أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ  بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ  بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ  فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا  فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ  سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا  وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{52:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 34, Saba (Sheba)
Verses 22 -- 42}

The 58th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{34:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Invoke those you claim [as deities] besides Allāh." They do not possess an atom's weight [of ability] in the heavens or on the earth, and they do not have therein any partnership [with Him], nor is there for Him from among them any assistant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): Call upon those whom ye set up beside Allah! They possess not an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor hath He an auxiliary among them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ  لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And intercession does not benefit with Him except for one whom He permits. [And those wait] until, when terror is removed from their hearts, they will say [to one another], "What has your Lord said?" They will say, "The truth." And He is the Most High, the Grand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: No intercession availeth with Him save for him whom He permitteth. Yet, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What was it that your Lord said? They say: The Truth. And He is the Sublime, the Great.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ عِندَهُٓ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ  حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا۟ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ  قَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ  وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Who provides for you from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "Allāh. And indeed, we or you are either upon guidance or in clear error."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  قُلِ ٱللَّهُ  وَإِنَّآ أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "You will not be asked about what we committed, and we will not be asked about what you do."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Ye will not be asked of what we committed, nor shall we be asked of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لَّا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّآ أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Show me those whom you have attached to Him as partners. No! Rather, He [alone] is Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Show me those whom ye have joined unto Him as partners. Nay (ye dare not)! For He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَرُونِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِ شُرَكَآءَ  كَلَّا  بَلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all mankind; but most of mankind know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: When is this promise (to be fulfilled) if ye are truthful?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "For you is the appointment of a Day [when] you will not remain thereafter an hour, nor will you precede [it]."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): Yours is the promise of a Day which ye cannot postpone nor hasten by an hour.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who disbelieve say, "We will never believe in this Qur’ān nor in that before it." But if you could see when the wrongdoers are made to stand before their Lord, refuting each others' words... Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "If not for you, we would have been believers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ  وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who were arrogant will say to those who were oppressed, "Did we avert you from guidance after it had come to you? Rather, you were criminals."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَـٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم  بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who were oppressed will say to those who were arrogant, "Rather, [it was your] conspiracy of night and day when you were ordering us to disbelieve in Allāh and attribute to Him equals." But they will [all] confide regret when they see the punishment; and We will put shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. Will they be recompensed except for what they used to do?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُٓ أَندَادًا  وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟  هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We did not send into a city any warner except that its affluent said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَـٰفِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "We are more [than the believers] in wealth and children, and we are not to be punished."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًا وَأَوْلَـٰدًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it], but most of the people do not know."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is not your wealth or your children that bring you nearer to Us in position, but it is [by being] one who has believed and done righteousness. For them there will be the double reward for what they did, and they will be in the upper chambers [of Paradise], safe [and secure].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَـٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the ones who strive against Our verses to cause [them] failure - those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Indeed, my Lord extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts [it] for him. But whatever thing you spend [in His cause] - He will compensate it; and He is the best of providers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ  وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ  وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] the Day when He will gather them all and then say to the angels, "Did these [people] used to worship you?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They will say, "Exalted are You! You, [O Allāh], are our benefactor excluding [i.e., not] them. Rather, they used to worship the jinn; most of them were believers in them."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم  بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ  أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{34:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] you do not hold for one another [the power of] benefit or harm, and We will say to those who wronged, "Taste the punishment of the Fire, which you used to deny."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 8}
\section{Surah 63, Al-Munāfiqūn (The Hypocrites)
All Verses (1 -- 11)}

The 104th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{63:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ  إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed so that they understand not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ  وَإِن يَقُولُوا۟ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ  كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ  يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ  هُمُ ٱلْعَدُوُّ فَٱحْذَرْهُمْ  قَـٰتَلَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ  أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوْا۟ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا۟  وَلِلَّهِ خَزَآئِنُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ ٱلْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا ٱلْأَذَلَّ  وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ  وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{63:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهَا  وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 2, Al-Baqarah (The Cow)
Verses 1 -- 171}

The 87th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{2:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Alif, Lām, Meem.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Alif. Lam. Mim.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 الٓمٓ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ  فِيهِ  هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ  وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ  وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ غِشَـٰوَةٌ  وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُخَـٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًا  وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ  أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَـٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَـٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing of the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَـٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ  وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌ بِٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَـٰرَهُمْ  كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟  وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فِرَٰشًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ  فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad ((\ar{ﷺ}))], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلْنَا عَلَىٰ عَبْدِنَا فَأْتُوا۟ بِسُورَةٍ مِّن مِّثْلِهِ وَٱدْعُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ  أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَشِّرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ  كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مِن ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزْقًا  قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى رُزِقْنَا مِن قَبْلُ  وَأُتُوا۟ بِهِ مُتَشَـٰبِهًا  وَلَهُمْ فِيهَآ أَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ  وَهُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْىِٓ أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا  فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ  وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا  يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِى بِهِ كَثِيرًا  وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِٓ إِلَّا ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ ٱللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَـٰقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَآ أَمَرَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِٓ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَكُنتُمْ أَمْوَٰتًا فَأَحْيَـٰكُمْ  ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَسَوَّىٰهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ  وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى جَاعِلٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً  قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَجْعَلُ فِيهَا مَن يُفْسِدُ فِيهَا وَيَسْفِكُ ٱلدِّمَآءَ وَنَحْنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَ  قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلْأَسْمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ أَنبِـُٔونِى بِأَسْمَآءِ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ  إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ أَنبِئْهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ  فَلَمَّآ أَنبَأَهُم بِأَسْمَآئِهِمْ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ ٱسْكُنْ أَنتَ وَزَوْجُكَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنْهَا رَغَدًا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمَا وَلَا تَقْرَبَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَأَزَلَّهُمَا ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ عَنْهَا فَأَخْرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيهِ  وَقُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ  وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِ كَلِمَـٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْنَا ٱهْبِطُوا۟ مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا  فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ  هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And believe in that which I reveal, confirming that which ye possess already (of the Scripture), and be not first to disbelieve therein, and part not with My revelations for a trifling price, and keep your duty unto Me.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهِ  وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱتَّقُونِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Confound not truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Establish worship, pay the poor-due, and bow your heads with those who bow (in worship).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱرْكَعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Enjoin ye righteousness upon mankind while ye yourselves forget (to practise it)? And ye are readers of the Scripture! Have ye then no sense?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ أَتَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَتَنسَوْنَ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ تَتْلُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ  أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Seek help in patience and prayer; and truly it is hard save for the humble-minded,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ  وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who know that they will have to meet their Lord, and that unto Him they are returning.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَٰجِعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you and how I preferred you to (all) creatures.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَنِّى فَضَّلْتُكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And guard yourselves against a day when no soul will in aught avail another, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be received from it, nor will they be helped.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا شَفَـٰعَةٌ وَلَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمْ  وَفِى ذَٰلِكُم بَلَآءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ فَرَقْنَا بِكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰكُمْ وَأَغْرَقْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We did appoint for Moses forty nights (of solitude), and then ye chose the calf, when he had gone from you, and were wrong-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ وَٰعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰٓ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذْتُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِن بَعْدِهِ وَأَنتُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then, even after that, We pardoned you in order that ye might give thanks.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ عَفَوْنَا عَنكُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We gave unto Moses the Scripture and the criterion (of right and wrong), that ye might be led aright.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْفُرْقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Ye have wronged yourselves by your choosing of the calf (for worship) so turn in penitence to your Creator, and kill (the guilty) yourselves. That will be best for you with your Creator and He will relent toward you. Lo! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّكُمْ ظَلَمْتُمْ أَنفُسَكُم بِٱتِّخَاذِكُمُ ٱلْعِجْلَ فَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ بَارِئِكُمْ فَٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ عِندَ بَارِئِكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ  إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when ye said: O Moses! We will not believe in thee till we see Allah plainly; and even while ye gazed the lightning seized you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَـٰكُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَوْتِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We caused the white cloud to overshadow you and sent down on you the manna and the quails, (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you - they wronged Us not, but they did wrong themselves.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ  كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ  وَمَا ظَلَمُونَا وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{2:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
