\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
كَمَثَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ ٱكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّنكَ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِى ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدَيْنِ فِيهَا  وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And be not ye as those who forgot Allah, therefor He caused them to forget their souls. Such are the evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The owners of the Garden, they are the victorious.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا يَسْتَوِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ  أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَـٰشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ  وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible. He is the Beneficent, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ  عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ  هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Grantor of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ  سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{59:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Producer, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ  لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ  يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 4, An-Nisā (The Women)
Verses 101 -- 113}

The 92nd revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{4:101}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you travel throughout the land, there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer, [especially] if you fear that those who disbelieve may disrupt [or attack] you. Indeed, the disbelievers are ever to you a clear enemy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when ye go forth in the land, it is no sin for you to curtail (your) worship if ye fear that those who disbelieve may attack you. In truth the disbelievers are an open enemy to you.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقْصُرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَن يَفْتِنَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كَانُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:102}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you [i.e., the commander of an army] are among them and lead them in prayer, let a group of them stand [in prayer] with you and let them carry their arms. And when they have prostrated, let them be [in position] behind you and have the other group come forward which has not [yet] prayed and let them pray with you, taking precaution and carrying their arms. Those who disbelieve wish that you would neglect your weapons and your baggage so they could come down upon you in one [single] attack. But there is no blame upon you, if you are troubled by rain or are ill, for putting down your arms, but take precaution. Indeed, Allāh has prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thou (O Muhammad) art among them and arrangest (their) worship for them, let only a party of them stand with thee (to worship) and let them take their arms. Then when they have performed their prostrations let them fall to the rear and let another party come that hath not worshipped and let them worship with thee, and let them take their precaution and their arms. Those who disbelieve long for you to neglect your arms and your baggage that they may attack you once for all. It is no sin for you to lay aside your arms, if rain impedeth you or ye are sick. But take your precaution. Lo! Allah prepareth for the disbelievers shameful punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا كُنتَ فِيهِمْ فَأَقَمْتَ لَهُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَلْتَقُمْ طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُم مَّعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَهُمْ فَإِذَا سَجَدُوا۟ فَلْيَكُونُوا۟ مِن وَرَآئِكُمْ وَلْتَأْتِ طَآئِفَةٌ أُخْرَىٰ لَمْ يُصَلُّوا۟ فَلْيُصَلُّوا۟ مَعَكَ وَلْيَأْخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَهُمْ وَأَسْلِحَتَهُمْ  وَدَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ تَغْفُلُونَ عَنْ أَسْلِحَتِكُمْ وَأَمْتِعَتِكُمْ فَيَمِيلُونَ عَلَيْكُم مَّيْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً  وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن كَانَ بِكُمْ أَذًى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوْ كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓا۟ أَسْلِحَتَكُمْ  وَخُذُوا۟ حِذْرَكُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:103}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when you have completed the prayer, remember Allāh standing, sitting, or [lying] on your sides. But when you become secure, re-establish [regular] prayer. Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When ye have performed the act of worship, remember Allah, standing, sitting and reclining. And when ye are in safety, observe proper worship. Worship at fixed times hath been enjoined on the believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِذَا قَضَيْتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قِيَـٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمْ  فَإِذَا ٱطْمَأْنَنتُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ  إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَـٰبًا مَّوْقُوتًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:104}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not weaken in pursuit of the enemy. If you should be suffering - so are they suffering as you are suffering, but you expect from Allāh that which they expect not. And Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Relent not in pursuit of the enemy. If ye are suffering, lo! they suffer even as ye suffer and ye hope from Allah that for which they cannot hope. Allah is ever Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ فِى ٱبْتِغَآءِ ٱلْقَوْمِ  إِن تَكُونُوا۟ تَأْلَمُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَأْلَمُونَ كَمَا تَأْلَمُونَ  وَتَرْجُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَرْجُونَ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:105}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book in truth so you may judge between the people by that which Allāh has shown you. And do not be for the deceitful an advocate.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We reveal unto thee the Scripture with the truth, that thou mayst judge between mankind by that which Allah showeth thee. And be not thou a pleader for the treacherous;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ  وَلَا تَكُن لِّلْخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:106}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:107}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not argue on behalf of those who deceive themselves. Indeed, Allāh loves not one who is a habitually sinful deceiver.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And plead not on behalf of (people) who deceive themselves. Lo! Allah loveth not one who is treacherous and sinful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تُجَـٰدِلْ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ خَوَّانًا أَثِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:108}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They conceal [their evil intentions and deeds] from the people, but they cannot conceal [them] from Allāh, and He is with them [in His knowledge] when they spend the night in such as He does not accept of speech. And ever is Allāh, of what they do, encompassing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They seek to hide from men and seek not to hide from Allah. He is with them when by night they hold discourse displeasing unto Him. Allah ever surroundeth what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَا يَسْتَخْفُونَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُمْ إِذْ يُبَيِّتُونَ مَا لَا يَرْضَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:109}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Here you are - those who argue on their behalf in [this] worldly life - but who will argue with Allāh for them on the Day of Resurrection, or who will [then] be their representative?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Ho! ye are they who pleaded for them in the life of the world. But who will plead with Allah for them on the Day of Resurrection, or who will then be their defender?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ جَـٰدَلْتُمْ عَنْهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَمَن يُجَـٰدِلُ ٱللَّهَ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَم مَّن يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:110}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever does a wrong or wrongs himself but then seeks forgiveness of Allāh will find Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Yet whoso doeth evil or wrongeth his own soul, then seeketh pardon of Allah, will find Allah Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ ٱللَّهَ يَجِدِ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:111}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever earns [i.e., commits] a sin only earns it against himself. And Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whoso committeth sin committeth it only against himself. Allah is ever Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَكْسِبْ إِثْمًا فَإِنَّمَا يَكْسِبُهُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:112}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But whoever earns an offense or a sin and then blames it on an innocent [person] has taken upon himself a slander and manifest sin.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And whoso committeth a delinquency or crime, then throweth (the blame) thereof upon the innocent, hath burdened himself with falsehood and a flagrant crime.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يَكْسِبْ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوْ إِثْمًا ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِ بَرِيٓـًٔا فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلَ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{4:113}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if it was not for the favor of Allāh upon you, [O Muḥammad], and His mercy, a group of them would have determined to mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they will not harm you at all. And Allāh has revealed to you the Book and wisdom and has taught you that which you did not know. And ever has the favor of Allāh upon you been great.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But for the grace of Allah upon thee (Muhammad), and His mercy, a party of them had resolved to mislead thee, but they will mislead only themselves and they will hurt thee not at all. Allah revealeth unto thee the Scripture and wisdom, and teacheth thee that which thou knewest not. The grace of Allah toward thee hath been infinite.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَتُهُ لَهَمَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُضِلُّوكَ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ  وَمَا يَضُرُّونَكَ مِن شَىْءٍ  وَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ مَا لَمْ تَكُن تَعْلَمُ  وَكَانَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 24, An-Nūr (The Light)
All Verses (1 -- 64)}

The 102nd revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{24:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَـٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍ  وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ  وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ  وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَـٰنِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَـٰدَةً أَبَدًا  وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَـٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ  إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ  إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ  لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم  بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ  لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ  وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ  فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَـٰنٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ  وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ  وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ  وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ  وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟  أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ٱلْغَـٰفِلَـٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلْخَبِيثَـٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَـٰتِ  وَٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ  لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا  ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ  وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟  هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَـٰعٌ لَّكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ  ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا  وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ  وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّـٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ  وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ  وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And marry such of you as are solitary and the pious of your slaves and maid-servants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is of ample means, Aware.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنكِحُوا۟ ٱلْأَيَـٰمَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمْ  إِن يَكُونُوا۟ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ  وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ  وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا  وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ  وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا۟ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمْ عَلَى ٱلْبِغَآءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ عَرَضَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا  وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مِن بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily We have sent down for you revelations that make plain, and the example of those who passed away before you. An admonition unto those who ward off (evil).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp; the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَوٰةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ  ٱلْمِصْبَاحُ فِى زُجَاجَةٍ  ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِىٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ  نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ  يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ لِلنَّاسِ  وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (This lamp is found) in houses which Allah hath allowed to be exalted and that His name shall be remembered therein. Therein do offer praise to Him at morn and evening.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فِى بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ ٱللَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلْـَٔاصَالِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رِجَالٌ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَـٰرَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ  يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did, and increase reward for them of His bounty. Allah giveth blessings without stint to whom He will.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ  وَٱللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍۭ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْـًٔا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُ  وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Or as darkness on a vast, abysmal sea. There covereth him a wave, above which is a wave, above which is a cloud. Layer upon layer of darkness. When he holdeth out his hand he scarce can see it. And he for whom Allah hath not appointed light, for him there is no light.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَوْ كَظُلُمَـٰتٍ فِى بَحْرٍ لُّجِّىٍّ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ  ظُلُمَـٰتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا  وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِن نُّورٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلطَّيْرُ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ  كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah is the journeying.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزْجِى سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِن بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَن مَّن يَشَآءُ  يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah causeth the revolution of the day and the night. Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for those who see.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُقَلِّبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ  إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ  فَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَمْشِى عَلَىٰٓ أَرْبَعٍ  يَخْلُقُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Verily We have sent down revelations and explained them. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍ مُّبَيِّنَـٰتٍ  وَٱللَّهُ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مِّن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ  وَمَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them, lo! a faction of them are averse;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ يَأْتُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ  بَلْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَن يَقُولُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا  وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ ٱللَّهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ  قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُوا۟  طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ  فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْ  وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا۟  وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath promised such of you as believe and do good work that He will surely make them to succeed (the present rulers) in the earth even as He caused those who were before them to succeed (others); and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He hath approved for them, and will give them in exchange safety after their fear. They serve Me. They ascribe no thing as partner unto Me. Those who disbelieve henceforth, they are the miscreants.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا ٱسْتَخْلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱرْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّن بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا  يَعْبُدُونَنِى لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِى شَيْـًٔا  وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey the messenger, that haply ye may find mercy.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ  وَلَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِيَسْتَـْٔذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا۟ ٱلْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مَرَّٰتٍ  مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِن بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلْعِشَآءِ  ثَلَـٰثُ عَوْرَٰتٍ لَّكُمْ  لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ  طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ  كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَا بَلَغَ ٱلْأَطْفَـٰلُ مِنكُمُ ٱلْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَـْٔذِنُوا۟ كَمَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ  كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِ  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّـٰتِى لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَن يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَـٰتٍۭ بِزِينَةٍ  وَأَن يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُنَّ  وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَـٰمِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ  لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَأْكُلُوا۟ جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا  فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَـٰرَكَةً طَيِّبَةً  كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They only are the true believers who believe in Allah and His messenger and, when they are with him on some common errand, go not away until they have asked leave of him. Lo! those who ask leave of thee, those are they who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they ask thy leave for some affair of theirs, give leave to whom thou wilt of them, and ask for them forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا۟ مَعَهُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُوهُ  إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَـْٔذِنُونَكَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ  فَإِذَا ٱسْتَـْٔذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Make not the calling of the messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knoweth those of you who steal away, hiding themselves. And let those who conspire to evade orders beware lest grief or painful punishment befall them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا تَجْعَلُوا۟ دُعَآءَ ٱلرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا  قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا  فَلْيَحْذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{24:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! verily unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. He knoweth your condition. And (He knoweth) the Day when they are returned unto Him so that He may inform them of what they did. Allah is Knower of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟  وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 33, Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces)
All Verses (1 -- 73)}

The 90th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{33:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Keep thy duty to Allah and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord. Lo! Allah is Aware of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And put thy trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as Trustee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ  وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath not assigned unto any man two hearts within his body, nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers) your mothers, nor hath He made those whom ye claim (to be your sons) your sons. This is but a saying of your mouths. But Allah saith the truth and He showeth the way.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَّا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِى جَوْفِهِ  وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَٰجَكُمُ ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى تُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ  وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَآءَكُمْ أَبْنَآءَكُمْ  ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَٰهِكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ يَقُولُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى ٱلسَّبِيلَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Proclaim their real parentage. That will be more equitable in the sight of Allah. And if ye know not their fathers, then (they are) your brethren in the faith, and your clients. And there is no sin for you in the mistakes that ye make unintentionally, but what your hearts purpose (that will be a sin for you). Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱدْعُوهُمْ لِـَٔابَآئِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ  فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوٓا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَٰنُكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ وَمَوَٰلِيكُمْ  وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَآ أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The Prophet is closer to the believers than their selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers. And the owners of kinship are closer one to another in the ordinance of Allah than (other) believers and the fugitives (who fled from Mecca), except that ye should do kindness to your friends. This is written in the Book (of nature).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ  وَأَزْوَٰجُهُٓ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ  وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ إِلَّآ أَن تَفْعَلُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَوْلِيَآئِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا  كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَسْطُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We exacted a covenant from the prophets, and from thee (O Muhammad) and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ مِيثَـٰقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ  وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَـٰقًا غَلِيظًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That He may ask the loyal of their loyalty. And He hath prepared a painful doom for the unfaithful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيَسْـَٔلَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ  وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you when there came against you hosts, and We sent against them a great wind and hosts ye could not see. And Allah is ever Seer of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes grew wild and hearts reached to the throats, and ye were imagining vain thoughts concerning Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There were the believers sorely tried, and shaken with a mighty shock.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, were saying: Allah and His messenger promised us naught but delusion.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed [i.e., unprotected]," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when a party of them said: O folk of Yathrib! There is no stand (possible) for you, therefor turn back. And certain of them (even) sought permission of the Prophet, saying: Our homes lie open (to the enemy). And they lay not open. They but wished to flee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟  وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ  إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If the enemy had entered from all sides and they had been exhorted to treachery, they would have committed it, and would have hesitated thereupon but little.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَـَٔاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they had already promised Allāh before not to turn their backs [i.e., flee]. And ever is the promise to Allāh [that about which one will be] questioned.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily they had already sworn unto Allah that they would not turn their backs (to the foe). An oath to Allah must be answered for.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ  وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Flight will not avail you if ye flee from death or killing, and then ye dwell in comfort but a little while.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allāh if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or any helper.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Who is he who can preserve you from Allah if He intendeth harm for you, or intendeth mercy for you. They will not find that they have any friend or helper other than Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً  وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Already Allāh knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah already knoweth those of you who hinder, and those who say unto their brethren: "Come ye hither unto us!" and they come not to the stress of battle save a little,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا  وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allāh has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Being sparing of their help to you (believers). But when the fear cometh, then thou (Muhammad) seest them regarding thee with rolling eyes like one who fainteth unto death. Then, when the fear departeth, they scald you with sharp tongues in their greed for wealth (from the spoil). Such have not believed. Therefor Allah maketh their deeds fruitless. And that is easy for Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ  فَإِذَا جَآءَ ٱلْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَٱلَّذِى يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ  فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ ٱلْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَأَحْبَطَ ٱللَّهُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ  وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They hold that the clans have not retired (for good); and if the clans should advance (again), they would fain be in the desert with the wandering Arabs, asking for the news of you; and if they were among you, they would not give battle, save a little.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَحْسَبُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا۟  وَإِن يَأْتِ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا۟ لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِى ٱلْأَعْرَابِ يَسْـَٔلُونَ عَنْ أَنبَآئِكُمْ  وَلَوْ كَانُوا۟ فِيكُم مَّا قَـٰتَلُوٓا۟ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Verily in the messenger of Allah ye have a good example for him who looketh unto Allah and the Last Day, and remembereth Allah much.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allāh and His Messenger had promised us, and Allāh and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when the true believers saw the clans, they said: This is that which Allah and His messenger promised us. Allah and His messenger are true. It did but confirm them in their faith and resignation.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ  وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّآ إِيمَـٰنًا وَتَسْلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Of the believers are men who are true to that which they covenanted with Allah. Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting; and they have not altered in the least;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا۟ مَا عَـٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ  فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ  وَمَا بَدَّلُوا۟ تَبْدِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
