\textit{M. Pickthall}: That Allah may reward the true men for their truth, and punish the hypocrites if He will, or relent toward them (if He will). Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ إِن شَآءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Allah repulsed the disbelievers in their wrath; they gained no good. Allah averted their attack from the believers. Allah is ever Strong, Mighty.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَرَدَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا  وَكَفَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلْقِتَالَ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He caused you to inherit their land and their houses and their wealth, and land ye have not trodden. Allah is ever Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَـٰرَهُمْ وَأَمْوَٰلَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوهَا  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Say unto thy wives: If ye desire the world's life and its adornment, come! I will content you and will release you with a fair release.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But if ye desire Allah and His messenger and the abode of the Hereafter, then lo! Allah hath prepared for the good among you an immense reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَٱلدَّارَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَـٰتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:30}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye wives of the Prophet! Whosoever of you committeth manifest lewdness, the punishment for her will be doubled, and that is easy for Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَـٰحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهَا ٱلْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ  وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:31}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And whosoever of you is submissive unto Allah and His messenger and doeth right, We shall give her her reward twice over, and We have prepared for her a rich provision.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا نُّؤْتِهَآ أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:32}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allāh, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye wives of the Prophet! Ye are not like any other women. If ye keep your duty (to Allah), then be not soft of speech, lest he in whose heart is a disease aspire (to you), but utter customary speech.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰنِسَآءَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ  إِنِ ٱتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:33}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And stay in your houses. Bedizen not yourselves with the bedizenment of the Time of Ignorance. Be regular in prayer, and pay the poor-due, and obey Allah and His messenger. Allah's wish is but to remove uncleanness far from you, O Folk of the Household, and cleanse you with a thorough cleansing.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَرْنَ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ  وَأَقِمْنَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتِينَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِعْنَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُٓ  إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ ٱلرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:34}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom. Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle and Aware.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And bear in mind that which is recited in your houses of the revelations of Allah and wisdom. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِى بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحِكْمَةِ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:35}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so - for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! men who surrender unto Allah, and women who surrender, and men who believe and women who believe, and men who obey and women who obey, and men who speak the truth and women who speak the truth, and men who persevere (in righteousness) and women who persevere, and men who are humble and women who are humble, and men who give alms and women who give alms, and men who fast and women who fast, and men who guard their modesty and women who guard (their modesty), and men who remember Allah much and women who remember - Allah hath prepared for them forgiveness and a vast reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَٱلْمُسْلِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرَٰتِ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعِينَ وَٱلْخَـٰشِعَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُتَصَدِّقَـٰتِ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰٓئِمَـٰتِ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَٱلْحَـٰفِظَـٰتِ وَٱلذَّٰكِرِينَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱلذَّٰكِرَٰتِ أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:36}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And it becometh not a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His messenger have decided an affair (for them), that they should (after that) claim any say in their affair; and whoso is rebellious to Allah and His messenger, he verily goeth astray in error manifest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُٓ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ ٱلْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ  وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَـٰلًا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:37}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when thou saidst unto him on whom Allah hath conferred favour and thou hast conferred favour: Keep thy wife to thyself, and fear Allah. And thou didst hide in thy mind that which Allah was to bring to light, and thou didst fear mankind whereas Allah hath a better right that thou shouldst fear Him. So when Zeyd had performed that necessary formality (of divorce) from her, We gave her unto thee in marriage, so that (henceforth) there may be no sin for believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have performed the necessary formality (of release) from them. The commandment of Allah must be fulfilled.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ  فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا  وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:38}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allāh has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allāh with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allāh a destiny decreed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is no reproach for the Prophet in that which Allah maketh his due. That was Allah's way with those who passed away of old - and the commandment of Allah is certain destiny -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَّا كَانَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُ  سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ  وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:39}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Who delivered the messages of Allah and feared Him, and feared none save Allah. Allah keepeth good account.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ  وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:40}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Muḥammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allāh and seal [i.e., last] of the prophets. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets; and Allah is ever Aware of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَآ أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن رَّسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـنَ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:41}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:42}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And glorify Him early and late.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:43}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He it is Who blesseth you, and His angels (bless you), that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and He is ever Merciful to the believers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَلِّى عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ  وَكَانَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:44}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَـٰمٌ  وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:45}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Lo! We have sent thee as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:46}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى ٱللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:47}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And announce unto the believers the good tidings that they will have great bounty from Allah.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:48}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And incline not to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Disregard their noxious talk, and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَىٰهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ  وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:49}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! If ye wed believing women and divorce them before ye have touched them, then there is no period that ye should reckon. But content them and release them handsomely.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا  فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:50}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allāh has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her; [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort [i.e., difficulty]. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Lo! We have made lawful unto thee thy wives unto whom thou hast paid their dowries, and those whom thy right hand possesseth of those whom Allah hath given thee as spoils of war, and the daughters of thine uncle on the father's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the father's side, and the daughters of thine uncle on the mother's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the mother's side who emigrated with thee, and a believing woman if she give herself unto the Prophet and the Prophet desire to ask her in marriage - a privilege for thee only, not for the (rest of) believers - We are Aware of that which We enjoined upon them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess - that thou mayst be free from blame, for Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِنَّآ أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَٰجَكَ ٱلَّـٰتِىٓ ءَاتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّآ أَفَآءَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّـٰتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَـٰلَـٰتِكَ ٱلَّـٰتِى هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَٱمْرَأَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِىِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ  قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:51}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: You, [O Muḥammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allāh knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Forbearing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Thou canst defer whom thou wilt of them and receive unto thee whom thou wilt, and whomsoever thou desirest of those whom thou hast set aside (temporarily), it is no sin for thee (to receive her again); that is better; that they may be comforted and not grieve, and may all be pleased with what thou givest them. Allah knoweth what is in your hearts (O men), and Allah is ever Forgiving, Clement.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ تُرْجِى مَن تَشَآءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِىٓ إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ  وَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ  ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ  وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:52}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Not lawful to you, [O Muḥammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allāh, over all things, an Observer.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is not allowed thee to take (other) women henceforth, nor that thou shouldst change them for other wives even though their beauty pleased thee, save those whom thy right hand possesseth. And Allah is ever Watcher over all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِن بَعْدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ رَّقِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:53}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allāh is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allāh an enormity.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Ye who believe! Enter not the dwellings of the Prophet for a meal without waiting for the proper time, unless permission be granted you. But if ye are invited, enter, and, when your meal is ended, then disperse. Linger not for conversation. Lo! that would cause annoyance to the Prophet, and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go); but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when ye ask of them (the wives of the Prophet) anything, ask it of them from behind a curtain. That is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to cause annoyance to the messenger of Allah, nor that ye should ever marry his wives after him. Lo! that in Allah's sight would be an enormity.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتَ ٱلنَّبِىِّ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَـٰظِرِينَ إِنَىٰهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَٱدْخُلُوا۟ فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ وَلَا مُسْتَـْٔنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ  إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى ٱلنَّبِىَّ فَيَسْتَحْىِ مِنكُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْىِ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ  وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَـٰعًا فَسْـَٔلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَآءِ حِجَابٍ  ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ  وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا۟ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَن تَنكِحُوٓا۟ أَزْوَٰجَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِٓ أَبَدًا  إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:54}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Whether ye divulge a thing or keep it hidden, lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِن تُبْدُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:55}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is no blame upon them [i.e., women] concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess [i.e., slaves]. And fear Allāh. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, Witness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is no sin for them (thy wives) to converse freely) with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters or of their own women, or their slaves. O women! Keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِىٓ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ وَلَآ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ وَلَآ أَبْنَآءِ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَآئِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ  وَٱتَّقِينَ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:56}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet. O ye who believe! Ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ  يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:57}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who abuse Allāh and His Messenger - Allāh has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who malign Allah and His messenger, Allah hath cursed them in the world and the Hereafter, and hath prepared for them the doom of the disdained.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:58}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلُوا۟ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:59}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers to draw their cloaks close round them (when they go abroad). That will be better, so that they may be recognised and not annoyed. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَٰجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَآءِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَـٰبِيبِهِنَّ  ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰٓ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:60}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little,

\textit{M. Pickthall}: If the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, and the alarmists in the city do not cease, We verily shall urge thee on against them, then they will be your neighbours in it but a little while.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْمُرْجِفُونَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَآ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:61}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Accursed, they will be seized wherever found and slain with a (fierce) slaughter.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مَّلْعُونِينَ  أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ أُخِذُوا۟ وَقُتِّلُوا۟ تَقْتِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:62}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That was the way of Allah in the case of those who passed away of old; thou wilt not find for the way of Allah aught of power to change.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ  وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:63}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَسْـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ  قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ  وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:64}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah hath cursed the disbelievers, and hath prepared for them a flaming fire,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:65}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا  لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:66}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger!

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَـٰلَيْتَنَآ أَطَعْنَا ٱللَّهَ وَأَطَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:67}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّآ أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَآءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا ٱلسَّبِيلَا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:68}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Our Lord! Oh, give them double torment and curse them with a mighty curse.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:69}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَاذَوْا۟ مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ ٱللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا۟  وَكَانَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَجِيهًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:70}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:71}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He will adjust your works for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeyeth Allah and His messenger, he verily hath gained a signal victory.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ  وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:72}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! he hath proved a tyrant and a fool.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا ٱلْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ  إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{33:73}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: So Allah punisheth hypocritical men and hypocritical women, and idolatrous men and idolatrous women. But Allah pardoneth believing men and believing women, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيُعَذِّبَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ وَيَتُوبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 12}
\section{Surah 48, Al-Fatĥ (The Victory)
All Verses (1 -- 29)}

The 111th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{48:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And that Allah may help thee with strong help -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ  وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment –

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph -

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ  وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَـٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ  عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ  وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ  وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner,

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ شَـٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet ((\ar{ﷺ}))] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ  فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ  وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَـٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا  يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ  قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا  بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِن بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ  يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَـٰمَ ٱللَّهِ  قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ  فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا  بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَـٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ  فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا  وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ  وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ  وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory;

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَـٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:19}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:20}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:21}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:22}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ قَـٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَـٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:23}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ  وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:24}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:25}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

\textit{M. Pickthall}: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ  وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌ مُّؤْمِنَـٰتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ  لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَآءُ  لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:26}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا  وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:27}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ  لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ  فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:28}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِ  وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{48:29}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ  وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ  تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًا  سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ  ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ  وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُ فَـَٔازَرَهُ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ  وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 49, Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms)
All Verses (1 -- 18)}

The 106th revealed Surah. Revealed in Madinah


\noindent[\textbf{49:1}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:2}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَـٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:3}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ  لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:4}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:5}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ  وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:6}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًا بِجَهَـٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَـٰدِمِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:7}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ  لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:8}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً  وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:9}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا  فَإِن بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَـٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ  فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:10}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:11}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ  وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَـٰبِ  بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ  وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:12}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ  وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا  أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ  وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:13}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟  إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:14}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا  قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ  وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَـٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا  إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:15}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَـٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ  أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّـٰدِقُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:16}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ  وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:17}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟  قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَـٰمَكُم  بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{49:18}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ  وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\chapter{Session 13}
\section{Surah 17, Al-'Isrā (The Night Journey)
Verses 78 -- 89}

The 50th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{17:78}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ  إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:79}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:80}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:81}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ  إِنَّ ٱلْبَـٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:82}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ  وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:83}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And when We bestow favor upon man [i.e., the disbeliever], he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And when We make life pleasant unto man, he turneth away and is averse; and when ill toucheth him he is in despair.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِ  وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:84}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Each one doth according to his rule of conduct, and thy Lord is Best Aware of him whose way is right.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:85}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They are asking thee concerning the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is by command of my Lord, and of knowledge ye have been vouchsafed but little.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ  قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:86}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And if We willed We could withdraw that which We have revealed unto thee, then wouldst thou find no guardian for thee against Us in respect thereof.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:87}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: (It is naught) save mercy from thy Lord. Lo! His kindness unto thee was ever great.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ  إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:88}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: Say: Verily, though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof though they were helpers one of another.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{17:89}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all kind of similitudes, but most of mankind refuse aught save disbelief.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}

\section{Surah 7, Al-'A`rāf (The Heights)
Verses 127 -- 157}

The 39th revealed Surah. Revealed in Makkah


\noindent[\textbf{7:127}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said, "Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: (O King), wilt thou suffer Moses and his people to make mischief in the land, and flout thee and thy gods? He said: We will slay their sons and spare their women, for lo! we are in power over them.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِ فِرْعَوْنَ أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُ لِيُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ  قَالَ سَنُقَتِّلُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَنَسْتَحْىِ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَإِنَّا فَوْقَهُمْ قَـٰهِرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:128}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allāh and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allāh. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And Moses said unto his people: Seek help in Allah and endure. Lo! the earth is Allah's. He giveth it for an inheritance to whom He will. And lo! the sequel is for those who keep their duty (unto Him).

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟  إِنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ لِلَّهِ يُورِثُهَا مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ  وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:129}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: They said: We suffered hurt before thou camest unto us, and since thou hast come unto us. He said: It may be that your Lord is going to destroy your adversary and make you viceroys in the earth, that He may see how ye behave.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
قَالُوٓا۟ أُوذِينَا مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَأْتِيَنَا وَمِن بَعْدِ مَا جِئْتَنَا  قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُهْلِكَ عَدُوَّكُمْ وَيَسْتَخْلِفَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:130}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine and dearth of fruits, that peradventure they might heed.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَآ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلسِّنِينَ وَنَقْصٍ مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:131}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: But when good [i.e., provision] came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allāh, but most of them do not know.

\textit{M. Pickthall}: But whenever good befell them, they said: This is ours; and whenever evil smote them they ascribed it to the evil auspices of Moses and those with him. Surely their evil auspice was only with Allah. But most of them knew not.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
فَإِذَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْحَسَنَةُ قَالُوا۟ لَنَا هَـٰذِهِ  وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَطَّيَّرُوا۟ بِمُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُٓ  أَلَآ إِنَّمَا طَـٰٓئِرُهُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:132}]
\textit{Saheeh Intl.}: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."

\textit{M. Pickthall}: And they said: Whatever portent thou bringest wherewith to bewitch us, we shall not put faith in thee.

{\Large
\begin{Arabic}
وَقَالُوا۟ مَهْمَا تَأْتِنَا بِهِ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ لِّتَسْحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
\end{Arabic}
}
\vspace{0.5ex}



\noindent[\textbf{7:133}]
